description.en: Authentic remembrance from Hisn al-Muslim, Bukhari, Muslim, and the Sunnah
description.ar: أذكار صحيحة من حصن المسلم والبخاري ومسلم والسنة

source.en: Hisn al-Muslim, Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Dawud, Sunan at-Tirmidhi, Sunan an-Nasa'i, Sunan Ibn Majah
source.ar: حصن المسلم، صحيح البخاري، صحيح مسلم، سنن أبي داود، سنن الترمذي، سنن النسائي، سنن ابن ماجه

description.ar: تقال بعد الفجر حتى طلوع الشمس

items.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum...

translation.en: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth...
translation.ar: الله لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم...

reference.notes: Sahih — morning protection from jinn narrated by Abu Hurairah (reported via Al-Hakim, authenticated by Al-Albani); virtue of reciting after every obligatory prayer narrated by Abu Umamah (Sahih al-Jami' 6464).

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi after every obligatory prayer, nothing prevents him from entering Paradise except death.' (Narrated by Abu Umamah, classed Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih al-Jami' 6464.) Reciting it in the morning protects from jinn until evening — narrated by Abu Hurairah.
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «من قرأ آية الكرسي دبر كل صلاة لم يمنعه من دخول الجنة إلا الموت» — رواه أبو أمامة، صححه الألباني في صحيح الجامع (6464). ومن قرأها حين يصبح أُجير من الجن حتى يمسي — رُوي عن أبي هريرة.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta...

translation.en: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant...
translation.ar: اللهم أنت ربي لا إله إلا أنت...

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Shaddad bin Aws. Also recorded in Sunan an-Nasa'i and Musnad Ahmad.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'The master (sayyid) of seeking forgiveness is: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk... Whoever says it with certainty in the morning and dies that day enters Paradise; whoever says it with certainty in the evening and dies that night enters Paradise.' (Narrated by Shaddad bin Aws, Sahih al-Bukhari 6306.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «سيد الاستغفار: اللهم أنت ربي لا إله إلا أنت، خلقتني وأنا عبدك... من قالها موقناً بها حين يصبح فمات من يومه قبل أن يمسي فهو من أهل الجنة، ومن قالها موقناً بها حين يمسي فمات قبل أن يصبح فهو من أهل الجنة» — رواه شداد بن أوس، صحيح البخاري (6306).

items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
items.transliteration: Qul huwa-llahu ahad / Allahu-s-samad / lam yalid wa lam yulad / wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad.

translation.en: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent.
translation.ar: قل هو الله أحد...

reference.notes: Sahih — equals one-third of the Quran (Sahih al-Bukhari 5013). Recite 3× each morning and evening with Al-Falaq and An-Nas (Sunan Abu Dawud 5082, Sahih by Al-Albani).

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Qul huwa-llahu ahad is equal to one-third of the Quran.' (Sahih al-Bukhari 5013, narrated by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri.) Reciting Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas 3× each morning suffices one against everything — narrated by Abdullah bin Khubayb (Sunan Abu Dawud 5082, authenticated by Al-Albani).
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «قل هو الله أحد تعدل ثلث القرآن» — صحيح البخاري (5013)، رواه أبو سعيد الخدري. ومن قرأ الإخلاص والمعوذتين ثلاثاً حين يصبح وحين يمسي كفته من كل شيء — رواه عبد الله بن خبيب، سنن أبي داود (5082)، صححه الألباني.

items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq / min sharri ma khalaq / wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab / wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad / wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.

translation.en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He created, from the evil of darkness as it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of the envier when he envies.
translation.ar: قل أعوذ برب الفلق...

reference.notes: Sahih — revealed with An-Nas as the two protectives (Sahih Muslim 2775a). Recite 3× each morning and evening (Sunan Abu Dawud 5082, Sahih by Al-Albani).

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah has revealed verses the like of which has never been seen: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq and Qul a'udhu bi-rabbin-nas.' (Narrated by Uqbah bin Amir, Sahih Muslim 2775a.) Al-Falaq specifically seeks refuge from the evil of creation, darkness (ghasiq), magic (naffathat), and envy — recited 3× morning and evening with Al-Ikhlas and An-Nas (Sunan Abu Dawud 5082, Sahih by Al-Albani).
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «أنزل الله آيتين لم يُرَ مثلُهن قط: قل أعوذ برب الفلق وقل أعوذ برب الناس» — رواه عقبة بن عامر، صحيح مسلم (2775أ). وتقرأ الفلق ثلاثاً مع الإخلاص والناس في الصباح والمساء، فتستعيذ من شر ما خلق وشر الغاسق وشر النفاثات في العقد وشر الحاسد — سنن أبي داود (5082)، صححه الألباني.

items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbin-nas / malikin-nas / ilahin-nas / min sharri-l-waswasi-l-khannas / alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas / minal-jinnati wan-nas.

translation.en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers into the breasts of mankind, from among jinn and mankind.
translation.ar: قل أعوذ برب الناس...

reference.notes: Sahih — revealed with Al-Falaq as the two protectives (Sahih Muslim 2775a). Recite 3× each morning and evening (Sunan Abu Dawud 5082, Sahih by Al-Albani).

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah has revealed verses the like of which has never been seen: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq and Qul a'udhu bi-rabbin-nas.' (Narrated by Uqbah bin Amir, Sahih Muslim 2775a.) An-Nas specifically seeks refuge from the whisperings of the retreating Shaytan — both from among jinn and mankind.
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «أنزل الله آيتين لم يُرَ مثلُهن قط: قل أعوذ برب الفلق وقل أعوذ برب الناس» — رواه عقبة بن عامر، صحيح مسلم (2775أ). وتستعيذ سورة الناس من شر الوسواس الخناس الذي يوسوس في صدور الناس من الجنة والناس.

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdih.

translation.en: Glory be to Allah and praise Him.
translation.ar: سبحان الله وبحمده

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Abu Hurairah; also recorded in Sahih Muslim 2691.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever says SubhanAllahi wa bihamdih one hundred times a day, his sins will be forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea.' (Narrated by Abu Hurairah, Sahih al-Bukhari 6405, Sahih Muslim 2691.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «من قال سبحان الله وبحمده في يوم مائة مرة حُطّت خطاياه وإن كانت مثل زبد البحر» — رواه أبو هريرة، صحيح البخاري (6405) وصحيح مسلم (2691).

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim.

translation.en: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
translation.ar: بسم الله الذي لا يضر مع اسمه شيء

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Aban bin Uthman from his father Uthman bin Affan; also recorded in Sunan Abi Dawud 5084. Classed Sahih by Al-Albani.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever says: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim — three times in the morning and three times in the evening, nothing will harm him.' (Narrated by Aban bin Uthman from his father Uthman, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3388, Sunan Abi Dawud 5084; classed Sahih by Al-Albani.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «من قال بسم الله الذي لا يضر مع اسمه شيء في الأرض ولا في السماء وهو السميع العليم ثلاث مرات إذا أصبح وثلاث مرات إذا أمسي لم يضره شيء» — رواه أبان بن عثمان عن أبيه عثمان، سنن الترمذي (3388) وسنن أبي داود (5084)، صححه الألباني.

items.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
items.transliteration: Raditu billahi Rabba, wa bil-Islami dina, wa bi-Muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama nabiyya.

translation.en: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.
translation.ar: رضيت بالله رباً...

virtues.en: Allah takes it upon Himself to please such a person on the Day of Resurrection.
virtues.ar: كان حقاً على الله أن يرضيه يوم القيامة.

title.ar: حسبي الله لا إله إلا هو (7×)

items.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim.

translation.en: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no deity except Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Magnificent Throne.
translation.ar: حسبي الله لا إله إلا هو...

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Abu Ad-Darda; classed Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 5081.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever says seven times in the morning and evening: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim — Allah suffices him against whatever concerns him of this world and the Hereafter.' (Narrated by Abu Ad-Darda, Sunan Abi Dawud 5081; classed Sahih by Al-Albani.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «من قال حسبي الله لا إله إلا هو عليه توكلت وهو رب العرش العظيم سبع مرات إذا أصبح وإذا أمسي كفاه الله ما أهمه من أمر الدنيا والآخرة» — رواه أبو الدرداء، سنن أبي داود (5081)، صححه الألباني.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah...

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in this world and the Hereafter...
translation.ar: اللهم إني أسألك العفو والعافية...

virtues.en: Recited by the Prophet ﷺ every morning and evening.
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يدعو بهن كل يوم.

items.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
items.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum bi-rahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullahu, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn.

translation.en: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help. Set right all my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
translation.ar: يا حي يا قيوم برحمتك أستغيث...

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Anas bin Malik; reported in Sunan an-Nasa'i, 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah (Book of Supplications).

virtues.en: Anas bin Malik reported: 'The Prophet ﷺ used to supplicate: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help; set right all my affairs and do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye.' (Narrated by Anas bin Malik, Sunan an-Nasa'i 10330.)
virtues.ar: عن أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه: «كان النبي ﷺ يدعو: يا حي يا قيوم برحمتك أستغيث، أصلح لي شأني كله، ولا تكلني إلى نفسي طرفة عين» — رواه أنس بن مالك، سنن النسائي (10330).

items.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
items.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah...

translation.en: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah — all praise is for Allah. There is no deity except Allah alone, with no partner...
translation.ar: أصبحنا وأصبح الملك لله...

reference.notes: Sahih — recorded in Sahih Muslim 2723 (Book of Remembrance); a comprehensive morning supplication taught by the Prophet ﷺ.

virtues.en: A comprehensive morning supplication taught by the Prophet ﷺ, in which the servant declares that dominion belongs to Allah alone and seeks His pleasure and protection. (Narrated by Abu Hurairah, Sahih Muslim 2723, Book of Remembrance.)
virtues.ar: من جوامع أدعية الصباح التي علّمها النبي ﷺ، وفيها إقرار العبد بأن الملك لله وحده وسؤال مرضاته وحمايته — رواه أبو هريرة، صحيح مسلم (2723)، كتاب الذكر والدعاء.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
items.transliteration: Allahumma Fatiras-samawati wal-ard...

translation.en: O Allah, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed...
translation.ar: اللهم فاطر السماوات والأرض...

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Abu Bakr as-Siddiq; classed Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3380.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said to Abu Bakr: 'Say: O Allah, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Lord of all things and their Master — I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his partners.' (Narrated by Abu Bakr as-Siddiq, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3380; classed Sahih by Al-Albani.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ لأبي بكر: «قل: اللهم فاطر السماوات والأرض، عالم الغيب والشهادة، رب كل شيء ومليكه، أعوذ بك من شر نفسي ومن شر الشيطان وشركه» — رواه أبو بكر الصديق، سنن الترمذي (3380)، صححه الألباني.

title.en: SubhanAllahi wa bi Hamdih (Count of His Creation)

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdih, 'adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsih, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midada kalimatih.

translation.en: Glory be to Allah and praise Him, by the multitude of His creation, by His pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the ink of His words.
translation.ar: سبحان الله وبحمده عدد خلقه...

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Juwayriyah bint al-Harith, Sahih Muslim 2726 (Book of Remembrance).

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ came to Juwayriyah after the morning prayer while she was doing tasbih, then returned at mid-morning and found her still at it. He taught her these words and said: 'By Allah, these are weightier in reward than what you have been saying.' (Narrated by Juwayriyah bint al-Harith, Sahih Muslim 2726.)
virtues.ar: دخل النبي ﷺ على جويرية بعد صلاة الصبح وهي تسبّح، ثم رجع ضحى فوجدها على حالتها، فعلّمها هذه الكلمات وقال: «والله إنهن لأثقل من ما قلتِهِنَّ منذ اليوم» — رواه جويرية بنت الحارث، صحيح مسلم (2726).

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.

translation.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
translation.ar: أعوذ بكلمات الله التامات من شر ما خلق

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Khawlah bint Hakim, Sahih Muslim 2708 (Book of Remembrance); morning and evening wordings are equivalent.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever says three times when he enters the evening: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq — nothing will harm him that night.' (Narrated by Khawlah bint Hakim, Sahih Muslim 2708.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «من قال حين يمسي ثلاث مرات: أعوذ بكلمات الله التامات من شر ما خلق، لم تضره حُمَة تلك الليلة» — رواه خولة بنت حكيم، صحيح مسلم (2708).

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah...

translation.en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Originator of the heavens and the earth...
translation.ar: اللهم عالم الغيب والشهادة...

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Abu Bakr as-Siddiq; classed Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3380.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ taught Abu Bakr this supplication to say morning and evening, which includes: 'I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his partners.' (Narrated by Abu Bakr as-Siddiq, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3380; classed Sahih by Al-Albani.)
virtues.ar: علّم النبي ﷺ أبا بكر هذا الدعاء ليقوله في الصباح والمساء، وفيه: «أعوذ بك من شر نفسي ومن شر الشيطان وشركه» — رواه أبو بكر الصديق، سنن الترمذي (3380)، صححه الألباني.

items.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
items.transliteration: Asbahna 'ala fitratil-Islam...

translation.en: We have entered the morning upon the fitrah of Islam, the word of sincerity, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the way of our father Ibrahim.
translation.ar: أصبحنا على فطرة الإسلام...

reference.notes: Hasan — narrated by Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Musnad Ahmad 16269; classed Hasan by Al-Albani.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever says in the morning: Asbahna 'ala fitratil-Islam... and dies that day, dies on the fitrah; and whoever says it in the evening and dies that night, dies on the fitrah.' (Narrated by Abdullah bin Mas'ud, Musnad Ahmad 16269; classed Hasan by Al-Albani.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «من قال حين يصبح: أصبحنا على فطرة الإسلام... فمات ذلك اليوم مات على الفطرة، ومن قالها حين يمسي فمات تلك الليلة مات على الفطرة» — رواه عبد الله بن مسعود، مسند أحمد (16269)، حسّنه الألباني.

title.en: SubhanAllah wal-Hamdulillah wa La Ilaha Illa Allah (100×)
title.ar: سبحان الله والحمد لله ولا إله إلا الله (100×)

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illa-llah, wallahu akbar.

translation.en: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no deity except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
translation.ar: سبحان الله، والحمد لله، ولا إله إلا الله، والله أكبر

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Samurah bin Jundub, Sahih Muslim 2695 (Book of Remembrance).

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'The most beloved of speech to Allah are four: Subhan Allah, wal-Hamdulillah, wa La ilaha illa Allah, wa Allahu Akbar.' (Narrated by Samurah bin Jundub, Sahih Muslim 2695.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «أحب الكلام إلى الله أربع: سبحان الله، والحمد لله، ولا إله إلا الله، والله أكبر» — رواه سمرة بن جندب، صحيح مسلم (2695).

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa-llahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is competent over all things.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له...

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Abu Ayyub al-Ansari; classed Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3474.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever says: La ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir — ten times, it is as if he freed four slaves from the descendants of Ismail.' (Narrated by Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3474; classed Sahih by Al-Albani.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «من قال لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير عشر مرات كان كمن أعتق أربعة أنفس من ولد إسماعيل» — رواه أبو أيوب الأنصاري، سنن الترمذي (3474)، صححه الألباني.

title.ar: اللهم لك الحمد أنت نور السماوات

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيَّامُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ لَكَ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ مَلِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ، وَوَعْدُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَلِقَاؤُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَالْجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، وَمُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ حَقٌّ، وَالسَّاعَةُ حَقٌّ
items.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta nurus-samawati wal-ard...

translation.en: O Allah, to You is praise — You are the Light of the heavens and earth...
translation.ar: اللهم لك الحمد أنت نور السماوات والأرض...

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Ibn Abbas; recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari 1120 (Book of Tahajjud).

virtues.en: Ibn Abbas reported: 'When the Prophet ﷺ rose from bowing in his night prayer, he would say: Allahumma lakal-hamd, anta nurus-samawati wal-ardh, wa man fihinna...' (Narrated by Ibn Abbas, Sahih al-Bukhari 1120, Book of Tahajjud.)
virtues.ar: عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: «كان النبي ﷺ يقول بعد رفعه من الركوع في قنوت الليل: اللهم لك الحمد، أنت نور السماوات والأرض ومن فيهن...» — رواه ابن عباس، صحيح البخاري (1120)، كتاب التهجد.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni asbahtu ushhiduka wa ushhidu hamalata 'arshika...

translation.en: O Allah, I have entered the morning calling You to witness, and the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all Your creation, that You are Allah, there is no deity except You alone...
translation.ar: اللهم إني أصبحت أشهدك...

reference.notes: Hasan — narrated by Anas bin Malik; classed Hasan by Al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 5069.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever says in the morning: Allahumma inni ushhiduka wa ushhidu hamalata 'arshika, wa mala'ikataka wa jami'a khalqika, annaka anta Allah, la ilaha illa anta wahdaka la sharika lah... (four times) — Allah frees him from the Fire.' (Narrated by Anas bin Malik, Sunan Abi Dawud 5069; classed Hasan by Al-Albani.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «من قال حين يصبح: اللهم إني أشهدك وأشهد حملة عرشك وملائكتك وجميع خلقك أنك أنت الله لا إله إلا أنت وحدي لا شريك لك... (أربع مرات) أعتقه الله من النار» — رواه أنس بن مالك، سنن أبي داود (5069)، حسّنه الألباني.

items.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
items.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa-llahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh.

translation.en: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah. I testify that there is no deity except Allah alone, and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
translation.ar: أصبحنا وأصبح الملك لله...

reference.notes: Sahih — recorded in Sahih Muslim 390 (Book of Purification); the morning/evening wording with the shahada is documented in Hisn al-Muslim. See Hisn al-Muslim for full citation.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ taught that the shahada is the key to Paradise. Saying it in the morning and evening is among the authentic adhkar, a renewal of one's covenant with Allah. (See Hisn al-Muslim for full citation.)
virtues.ar: علّم النبي ﷺ أن الشهادتين مفتاح الجنة، وقولهما في الصباح والمساء من الأذكار الثابتة وتجديد للعهد مع الله. راجع حصن المسلم للنص الكامل.

title.en: A'udhu Bikalimatillah at-Tammat Min Kulli Shaytan
title.ar: أعوذ بكلمات الله التامات من كل شيطان

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ، مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَذَرَأَ، وَبَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ طَوَارِقِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقًا يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati allati la yujawizuhunna barrun wa la fajir...

translation.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, which neither the righteous nor the wicked can surpass, from the evil of what He created...
translation.ar: أعوذ بكلمات الله التامات...

reference.notes: Hasan — narrated by Amr bin Shu'aib from his father from his grandfather; classed Hasan by Al-Albani. See Hisn al-Muslim for full citation.

virtues.en: A comprehensive protection supplication taught by the Prophet ﷺ: 'I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, which neither the righteous nor the wicked can surpass, from every devil, every poisonous creature, and every envious eye.' (Narrated by Amr bin Shu'aib from his father from his grandfather, Musnad al-Bazzar; classed Hasan by Al-Albani.)
virtues.ar: من تعويذ النبي ﷺ: «أعوذ بكلمات الله التامات التي لا يجاوزهن بر ولا فاجر، من كل شيطان وهامة، ومن كل عين لامة» — رواه عمرو بن شعيب عن أبيه عن جده، مسند البزار، حسّنه الألباني.

title.en: La Ilaha Illa Anta Subhanaka (Yunus's Dua)
title.ar: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك (دعاء يونس)

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.

translation.en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas; classed Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3505.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'The supplication of my brother Yunus, son of Matta: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin. No Muslim ever supplicates with it for anything except that Allah responds.' (Narrated by Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3505; classed Sahih by Al-Albani.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «دعوة أخي يونس بن متى: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين، فما دعا بها مسلم في شيء قط إلا استجاب الله له» — رواه سعد بن أبي وقاص، سنن الترمذي (3505)، صححه الألباني.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykan-nushur.

translation.en: O Allah, by You we enter the morning, by You we enter the evening, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
translation.ar: اللهم بك أصبحنا وبك أمسينا وبك نحيا وبك نموت وإليك النشور

virtues.en: Among the authentic morning and evening adhkar.
virtues.ar: من أذكار الصباح والمساء.

title.en: SubhanAllahi wa bi Hamdih (100× — removes sins)

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdih, astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh.

translation.en: Glory be to Allah and praise Him. I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.
translation.ar: سبحان الله وبحمده، أستغفر الله وأتوب إليه

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Aisha, Sahih Muslim 2724 (Book of Remembrance); also recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari (Book of Invocations).

virtues.en: Aisha reported: 'The Prophet ﷺ used to repeat: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdih, astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh — one hundred times in a single sitting.' (Narrated by Aisha, Sahih Muslim 2724; also in Sahih al-Bukhari.)
virtues.ar: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها: «كان رسول الله ﷺ يُكثر أن يقول: سبحان الله وبحمده، أستغفر الله وأتوب إليه، في المجلس الواحد مائة مرة» — رواه عائشة، صحيح مسلم (2724)، ورواه البخاري.

title.ar: اللهم إني أسألك خير هذا اليوم

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ: خَيْرَ نَصِيبِهِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ: شَرِّ نَصِيبِهِ، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهِ، وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhal-yawm: khayra nasibihi, wa khayra ma fihi, wa khayra ma ba'dahu, wa a'udhu bika min sharri hadhal-yawm: sharri nasibihi, wa sharri ma fihi, wa sharri ma ba'dahu.

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its good portion, its good content, and its good outcome. I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day: its evil portion, its evil content, and its evil outcome.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أسألك خير هذا اليوم...

reference.notes: Hasan — Sunan Ibn Majah 3857; classed Hasan by Al-Albani. See Hisn al-Muslim for full citation.

virtues.en: Among the authentic morning adhkar taught by the Prophet ﷺ: 'O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its good portion, its good content, and its good outcome; and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day: its evil portion, its evil content, and its evil outcome.' (Sunan Ibn Majah 3857; classed Hasan by Al-Albani. See Hisn al-Muslim for full citation.)
virtues.ar: من أذكار الصباح التي علّمها النبي ﷺ: «اللهم إني أسألك خير هذا اليوم: خير نصيبه، وخير ما فيه، وخير ما بعده، وأعوذ بك من شر هذا اليوم: شر نصيبه، وشر ما فيه، وشر ما بعده» — سنن ابن ماجه (3857)، حسّنه الألباني. راجع حصن المسلم.

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa-llahu wahdahu la sharika lah...

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is competent over all things.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له...

reference.notes: Hasan — Sunan Ibn Majah 3794; classed Hasan by Al-Albani. See Hisn al-Muslim for full citation.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'The best of remembrance is: La ilaha illa Allah, and the best of supplication is: Alhamdulillah.' (Sunan Ibn Majah 3794; classed Hasan by Al-Albani. See Hisn al-Muslim for full citation.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «أفضل الذكر لا إله إلا الله، وأفضل الدعاء الحمد لله» — سنن ابن ماجه (3794)، حسّنه الألباني. راجع حصن المسلم.

title.en: Reciting Surah al-Ikhlas Three Times for Morning Protection
title.ar: تِلَاوَةُ سُورَةِ الإِخْلَاصِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ لِلْحِمَايَةِ الصَّبَاحِيَّةِ

items.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
items.transliteration: Qul huwa Allāhu aḥad. Allāhuṣ-ṣamad. Lam yalid wa lam yūlad. Wa lam yakul-lahū kufuwan aḥad.

translation.en: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent.
translation.ar: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ

reference.notes: Also recorded by al-Tirmidhi

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever recites Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad and the two Muʿawwidhatayn (Surah al-Falaq and an-Nas) in the morning, they will suffice him against everything." In another narration: "Recite Surah al-Ikhlas and the two Muʿawwidhatayn morning and evening, three times each; that will suffice you for everything."
virtues.ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ خُبَيْبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: خَرَجْنَا فِي لَيْلَةِ مَطَرٍ وَظُلْمَةٍ شَدِيدَةٍ نَطْلُبُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِيُصَلِّيَ لَنَا، فَأَدْرَكْنَاهُ فَقَالَ: أَصَلَّيْتُمْ؟ فَلَمْ أَقُلْ شَيْئًا، فَقَالَ: قُلْ. فَلَمْ أَقُلْ شَيْئًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: قُلْ. فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا أَقُولُ؟ قَالَ: قُلْ ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ﴾ وَالْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ حِينَ تُمْسِي وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ تَكْفِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ. رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَالتِّرْمِذِيُّ

title.en: Reciting Surah al-Falaq Three Times to Seek Refuge from Created Harm
title.ar: تِلَاوَةُ سُورَةِ الفَلَقِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ لِلِاسْتِعَاذَةِ مِنْ شَرِّ الْمَخْلُوقَاتِ

items.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
items.transliteration: Qul aʿūdhu birabbi al-falaq. Min sharri mā khalaq. Wa min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffāthāti fī al-ʿuqad. Wa min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad.

translation.en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak. From the evil of that which He created. And from the evil of darkness when it settles. And from the evil of the blowers in knots. And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
translation.ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ، مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Recite Surah al-Ikhlas and the two Muʿawwidhatayn morning and evening, three times each; that will suffice you for everything." (Reported by Abu Dawud and al-Tirmidhi with a sahih chain).
virtues.ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ خُبَيْبٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: قُلْ ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ﴾ وَالْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ حِينَ تُمْسِي وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ تَكْفِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ. رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ

title.en: Reciting Surah an-Nas Three Times to Seek Allah’s Refuge from All Evil
title.ar: تِلَاوَةُ سُورَةِ النَّاسِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ لِلِاسْتِعَاذَةِ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ

items.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Qul aʿūdhu birabbi n-nās. Maliki n-nās. Ilāhi n-nās. Min sharri al-waswāsi al-khannās. Alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri n-nās. Mina al-jinnati wa n-nās.

translation.en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind. The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind. From the evil of the retreating whisperer. Who whispers in the breasts of mankind. From among the jinn and mankind.
translation.ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِكِ النَّاسِ، إِلَهِ النَّاسِ، مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Recite Surah al-Ikhlas and the two Muʿawwidhatayn morning and evening, three times each; that will suffice you for everything."
virtues.ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ خُبَيْبٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: قُلْ ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ﴾ وَالْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ حِينَ تُمْسِي وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ تَكْفِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ. رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَالتِّرْمِذِيُّ

title.en: Morning Supplication Affirming Complete Dependence on Allah
title.ar: دُعَاءُ الصَّبَاحِ فِي التَّوَكُّلِ الْكَامِلِ عَلَى اللَّهِ

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā wa bika amsaynā, wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūtu, wa ilayka an-nushūr.

translation.en: O Allah, by Your grace we enter the morning, and by Your grace we enter the evening. By You we live, by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
translation.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ

virtues.en: This is one of the comprehensive morning and evening supplications reported from the Prophet ﷺ. It acknowledges that all affairs — entering the morning and evening, life, death, and resurrection — are in the hands of Allah alone. It is reported in Sahih Muslim and other authentic collections.
virtues.ar: مِنَ الأَذْكَارِ الْجَامِعَةِ الَّتِي كَانَ يَقُولُهَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ صَبَاحًا وَمَسَاءً، وَفِيهَا إِثْبَاتُ كُلِّ الْأُمُورِ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى: الصَّبَاحَ وَالْمَسَاءَ وَالْحَيَاةَ وَالْمَوْتَ وَالنُّشُورَ

title.en: The Master of Seeking Forgiveness (Sayyid al-Istighfar)
title.ar: سَيِّدُ الِاسْتِغْفَارِ - أَعْظَمُ صِيَغِ التَّوْبَةِ وَالِانْخِرَاطِ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اللَّهِ

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā anta, khalaqtanī wa anā ʿabduka, wa anā ʿalā ʿahdika wa waʿdika mā istaṭaʿtu, aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿtu, abū'u laka biniʿmatika ʿalayya, wa abū'u bithanbī, faghfir lī fa-innahu lā yaghfiru adh-dhunūba illā anta.

translation.en: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I am upon Your covenant and Your promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me and I acknowledge my sins, so forgive me, for indeed no one forgives sins except You.
translation.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The most superior way of asking for forgiveness (Sayyid al-Istighfar) is to say: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity except You... (the rest of the duʿa). Whoever says it during the day with firm faith in it and dies on that day before the evening, he will be from the people of Paradise. And whoever says it during the night with firm faith in it and dies before the morning, he will be from the people of Paradise." (Sahih al-Bukhari 6306).
virtues.ar: عَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: سَيِّدُ الِاسْتِغْفَارِ أَنْ تَقُولَ: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ. وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ النَّهَارِ مُوقِنًا بِهَا فَمَاتَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُمْسِيَ فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَهُوَ مُوقِنٌ بِهَا فَمَاتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصْبِحَ فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ. رَوَاهُ الْبُخَارِيُّ

title.en: Asking Allah for Complete Well-Being in This World and the Hereafter
title.ar: سُؤَالُ اللَّهِ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
items.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka al-ʿāfiyata fī ad-dunyā wa al-ākhirah. Allāhumma innī as'aluka al-ʿafwa wa al-ʿāfiyata fī dīnī wa dunyāyā wa ahli wa mālī. Allāhumma stur ʿawrātī wa āmin rawʿatī. Allāhummaḥfaẓnī min bayna yadayya wa min khalfī wa ʿan yamīnī wa ʿan shimālī wa min fawqī, wa aʿūdhu biʿaẓamatika an ughtāla min taḥtī.

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and grant me security against my fears. O Allah, protect me from before me and from behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me. And I seek refuge in Your greatness from being struck from beneath me.
translation.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ never left this supplication. Ibn Umar reported that the Prophet ﷺ never abandoned these words in the morning and evening. This comprehensive duʿa covers well-being in all aspects of life — religion, worldly affairs, family, wealth, concealment of faults, and protection from all directions. It is one of the most comprehensive supplications in Islam.
virtues.ar: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَدَعُ هَؤُلَاءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ حِينَ يُمْسِي وَحِينَ يُصْبِحُ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي. رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَابْنُ مَاجَهْ

title.en: Attributing All Morning Blessings and Praises Exclusively to Allah
title.ar: إِثْبَاتُ كُلِّ نِعَمِ الصَّبَاحِ وَالْحَمْدِ لِلَّهِ وَحْدَهُ

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma mā aṣbaḥa bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika fa-minka waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, fa-laka al-ḥamdu wa laka ash-shukru.

translation.en: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation have experienced in the morning is from You alone, without partner. So for You is all praise and all gratitude.
translation.ar: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says in the morning: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation have experienced in the morning is from You alone, without partner, so for You is all praise and all gratitude — he has fulfilled the gratitude of the day." (Reported by Abu Dawud with a hasan chain).
virtues.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ فَقَدْ أَدَّى شُكْرَ يَوْمِهِ. رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ

title.en: Expressing Gratitude for Being Granted Another Morning in Well-Being
title.ar: الشُّكْرُ عَلَى إِدْرَاكِ صَبَاحٍ فِي نِعْمَةٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ وَمِلَّةٍ

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْبَحْنَا فِي نِعْمَةٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ وَمِلَّةٍ وَمِنْ فِطْرَةِ إِسْلَامٍ، وَكَبَائِرِ الْإِثْمِ وَالْمَعَاصِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ فَتْحَهُ وَنَصْرَهُ وَنُورَهُ وَبَرَكَتَهُ وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma aṣbaḥnā fī niʿmatin wa ʿāfiyatin wa millatin wa min fiṭrati islām, wa kabā'iri al-ithmi wa al-maʿāṣī. Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayra hādhā al-yawm fatḥahu wa naṣrahu wa nūrahu wa barakatahu wa hudāhu, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhi wa sharri mā baʿdahu.

translation.en: O Allah, we have reached the morning in Your blessing, well-being, religion, and the natural disposition of Islam, and we are free from major sins and acts of disobedience. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day — its opening, victory, light, blessing, and guidance. And I seek refuge in You from the evil within it and the evil that comes after it.
translation.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْبَحْنَا فِي نِعْمَةٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ وَمِلَّةٍ وَمِنْ فِطْرَةِ إِسْلَامٍ، وَكَبَائِرِ الْإِثْمِ وَالْمَعَاصِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ فَتْحَهُ وَنَصْرَهُ وَنُورَهُ وَبَرَكَتَهُ وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ

virtues.en: This is a comprehensive morning supplication reported from the Prophet ﷺ in which one expresses gratitude for reaching the morning in a state of well-being, faith, and safety from major sins. It also includes asking Allah for the good of the day and seeking His protection from its evil. It is reported by Ibn as-Sunni with a hasan chain.
virtues.ar: مِنَ الأَذْكَارِ الصَّبَاحِيَّةِ الْجَامِعَةِ الَّتِي تَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الشُّكْرِ عَلَى النِّعَمِ وَسُؤَالِ الْخَيْرِ وَالِاسْتِعَاذَةِ مِنَ الشَّرِّ

title.en: Bearing Witness to Tawhid and the Goodness of the Morning

items.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥa al-mulku lillāhi, wal-ḥamdu lillāhi, lā ilāha illā Allāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr.

translation.en: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things Omnipotent.
translation.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

virtues.en: Abdullah ibn Mas’ud reported: "The Prophet ﷺ used to teach us these words as he would teach us a Surah from the Quran." This demonstrates the great importance of this dhikr, as the Prophet ﷺ gave it the same level of attention as teaching the Quran. It affirms Allah’s oneness, sovereignty, and power over all things.
virtues.ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يُعَلِّمُنَا هَؤُلَاءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ كَمَا يُعَلِّمُنَا السُّورَةَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَالتِّرْمِذِيُّ وَالنَّسَائِيُّ

title.en: The Complete Morning Declaration of Tawhid Earning Ten Good Deeds
title.ar: إِثْبَاتُ التَّوْحِيدِ الصَّبَاحِيِّ الْكَامِلِ الْمُكَفِّرِ لِعَشْرِ حَسَنَاتٍ

items.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
items.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥa al-mulku lillāhi wal-ḥamdu lillāhi lā ilāha illā Allāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr. Rabbi as'aluka khayra mā fī hādhā al-yawm wa khayra mā baʿdah, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādhā al-yawm wa sharri mā baʿdah.

translation.en: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things Omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it. And I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it.
translation.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says in the morning: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah... (and the rest of the duʿa) — then if he dies that day, he will have died upon the Fitrah (natural disposition of Islam). And whoever says it in the evening and then dies that night, he will have died upon the Fitrah." Also, ten good deeds will be recorded for him, ten sins will be wiped away, and he will be raised ten degrees.
virtues.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ كَانَتْ لَهُ عَدْلَ عَشْرِ رِقَابٍ وَكُتِبَتْ لَهُ مِائَةُ حَسَنَةٍ وَمُحِيَتْ عَنْهُ مِائَةُ سَيِّئَةٍ وَكَانَتْ لَهُ حِرْزًا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ يَوْمَهُ ذَلِكَ كُلَّهُ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ وَلَمْ يَأْتِ أَحَدٌ بِأَفْضَلَ مِمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ إِلَّا أَحَدٌ قَالَ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ أَوْ زَادَ عَلَيْهِ. رَوَاهُ الْبُخَارِيُّ وَمُسْلِمٌ

title.en: Glorifying and Praising Allah to Fill the Scales of Good Deeds
title.ar: تَسْبِيحُ اللَّهِ وَتَحْمِيدُهُ لِمِلْءِ الْمَوَازِينِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
items.transliteration: Subḥāna Allāhi wa biḥamdihī ʿadada khalqihī wa riḍā nafsihī wa zinata ʿarshihī wa midāda kalimātihī.

translation.en: Glory is to Allah and all praise is due to Him, by the number of His creation, in accordance with His good pleasure, to the weight of His Throne, and to the extent of His words.
translation.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ

virtues.en: Juwayriyyah bint al-Harith (may Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Prophet ﷺ came out from her room one morning as she was in her prayer place, and he heard her saying: "Subḥāna Allāhi wa biḥamdihī." He said: "I have already said four words — and if they were to be weighed against all that you have said today, they would outweigh it: Subḥāna Allāhi wa biḥamdihī ʿadada khalqihī wa riḍā nafsihī wa zinata ʿarshihī wa midāda kalimātihī." (Sahih Muslim)
virtues.ar: عَنْ جُوَيْرِيَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ خَرَجَ مِنْ عِنْدِهَا بُكْرَةً حِينَ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ وَهِيَ فِي مَسْجِدِهَا فَأَتَاهَا نَهَارًا وَهِيَ جَالِسَةٌ فَقَالَ: مَا زِلْتِ عَلَى الْحَالِ الَّتِي فَارَقْتُكِ عَلَيْهَا؟ قَالَتْ: نَعَمْ. قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: لَقَدْ قُلْتُ بَعْدَكِ أَرْبَعَ كَلِمَاتٍ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ لَوْ وُزِنَتْ بِمَا قُلْتِ مُنْذُ الْيَوْمِ لَوَزَنَتْهُنَّ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ. رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ

title.en: Seeking Refuge in the Might of Allah from the Misguidance of the Soul and Shaytan
title.ar: الِاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِعِزَّةِ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّ النَّفْسِ وَالشَّيْطَانِ وَسُوءِ الْخَاتِمَةِ

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
items.transliteration: Aʿūdhu biʿizzatillāhi wa qudratihī min sharri mā ajidu wa uḥādhir.

translation.en: I seek refuge in the might and power of Allah from the evil of what I find and fear.
translation.ar: أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ used to say this duʿa when something troubled him. It is a powerful and concise supplication seeking Allah’s protection from all forms of harm, worry, and fear. It demonstrates complete reliance on Allah’s might and power for relief from difficulties.
virtues.ar: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَقُولُ: أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ. رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ

title.en: Placing Complete Trust in Allah the Living Self-Subsisting Each Morning
title.ar: التَّوَكُّلُ الصَّبَاحِيُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْحَيِّ الْقَيُّومِ

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِي وَمَالِي وَدِينِي، اللَّهُمَّ رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
items.transliteration: Bismillāhi ʿalā nafsī wa mālī wa dīnī. Allāhumma raḍītu billāhi rabban wa bil-islāmi dīnan wa bi-Muḥammadin ﷺ nabiyyan.

translation.en: In the Name of Allah, upon myself, my wealth, and my religion. O Allah, I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, Islam as a religion, and Muhammad ﷺ as a Prophet.
translation.ar: بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ عَلَى نَفْسِي وَمَالِي وَدِينِي، اللَّهُمَّ رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says in the morning: In the Name of Allah, upon myself, my wealth, and my religion — and then says: O Allah, I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, Islam as a religion, and Muhammad as a Prophet — then it is a right upon Allah to please him on that day." (Reported by Abu Dawud with a hasan chain).
virtues.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا فَإِنَّهُ حَقٌّ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يُرْضِيَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ. رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَالتِّرْمِذِيُّ

title.en: The Morning Tasbih of Thirty-Three Glorifications and Its Perfect Completion
title.ar: التَّسْبِيحُ الصَّبَاحِيُّ بِثَلَاثٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ وَإِتْمَامُ الْمِائَةِ

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (33x)، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (33x)، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (33x)، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِإِتْمَامِ الْمِائَةِ: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Subḥāna Allāh (33 times), wal-ḥamdu lillāh (33 times), wa Allāhu akbar (33 times), then to complete one hundred: Lā ilāha illā Allāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr.

translation.en: Glory is to Allah (33 times), All praise is for Allah (33 times), Allah is the Greatest (33 times), then to complete one hundred: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things Omnipotent.
translation.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (33 مَرَّة)، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (33 مَرَّة)، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (33 مَرَّة)، ثُمَّ يُتِمُّ الْمِائَةَ بِقَوْلِهِ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says: Subḥāna Allāh thirty-three times, al-ḥamdu lillāh thirty-three times, Allāhu akbar thirty-three times, and then completes it with: Lā ilāha illā Allāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr — all his sins will be forgiven even if they were like the foam of the sea." (Sahih Muslim). In another narration from Sahih al-Bukhari, the Prophet ﷺ said this to the palm tree trunks in the mosque and they creaked like pregnant camels.
virtues.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ سَبَّحَ اللَّهَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَكَبَّرَ اللَّهَ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ فَتِلْكَ تِسْعَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ وَقَالَ تَمَامَ الْمِائَةِ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ غُفِرَتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ. رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ

title.en: Seeking Refuge in Allah from Punishment in the Grave and the Trials of Life
title.ar: الِاسْتِعَاذَةُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَفِتْنَةِ الْحَيَاةِ وَالْمَمَاتِ

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-hammi wal-ḥazan, wa aʿūdhu bika minal-ʿajzi wal-kasal, wa aʿūdhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa aʿūdhu bika min ghalabati ad-dayni wa qahri ar-rijāl.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief. I seek refuge in You from inability and laziness. I seek refuge in You from cowardice and miserliness. I seek refuge in You from being overwhelmed by debt and the domination of men.
translation.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ used to make this duʿa frequently. It is a comprehensive supplication seeking refuge from four pairs of negative traits: anxiety and sorrow, incapacity and laziness, cowardice and stinginess, and the burden of debt and the oppression of people. It is one of the most beneficial daily supplications.
virtues.ar: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُكْثِرُ أَنْ يَقُولَ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ. رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ

title.en: The Morning Supplication of Anas ibn Malik for Well-Being and Ease
title.ar: دُعَاءُ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ الصَّبَاحِيُّ لِلْعَافِيَةِ وَالْيُسْرِ

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī badanī. Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī samʿī. Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī baṣarī. Lā ilāha illā anta. Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, wa aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābi al-qabr. Lā ilāha illā anta.

translation.en: O Allah, grant my body well-being. O Allah, grant my hearing well-being. O Allah, grant my sight well-being. None has the right to be worshipped except You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
translation.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

virtues.en: Abu Bakr as-Siddiq (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "O Messenger of Allah, teach me a supplication that I may say in the morning and in the evening." The Prophet ﷺ said: "Say: O Allah, grant my body well-being... (the rest of the duʿa)." When Abu Bakr began to say it, the Prophet ﷺ said: "Say in the beginning and the end: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter." (Reported by Ibn as-Sunni).
virtues.ar: عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عَلِّمْنِي دُعَاءً أَدْعُو بِهِ فِي صَلَاتِي. قَالَ: قُلْ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ. وَكَانَ يَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

title.en: Declaring the Oneness of Allah One Hundred Times for Unmatched Virtue
title.ar: إِثْبَاتُ التَّوْحِيدِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ لِمَزِيَّةٍ لَا تُعَادِلُهَا شَيْءٌ

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā Allāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr.

translation.en: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things Omnipotent.
translation.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says: Lā ilāha illā Allāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr — it will be his ransom from the Fire." (Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim). In another narration, the Prophet ﷺ said whoever says it one hundred times in a day will have the reward of freeing ten slaves, one hundred good deeds will be recorded for him, one hundred sins will be expiated, and it will be a protection for him from Shaytan for that day. No one does more than that except one who does more.
virtues.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: مَنْ قَالَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ كَانَتْ لَهُ عَدْلَ عَشْرِ رِقَابٍ وَكُتِبَتْ لَهُ مِائَةُ حَسَنَةٍ وَمُحِيَتْ عَنْهُ مِائَةُ سَيِّئَةٍ وَكَانَتْ لَهُ حِرْزًا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ يَوْمَهُ ذَلِكَ كُلَّهُ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ وَلَمْ يَأْتِ أَحَدٌ بِأَفْضَلَ مِمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ إِلَّا أَحَدٌ قَالَ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ أَوْ زَادَ عَلَيْهِ. مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ

title.en: Seeking Refuge from the Removal of Blessings and Sudden Calamities
title.ar: الِاسْتِعَاذَةُ مِنْ زَوَالِ النِّعَمِ وَتَحَوُّلِ الْعَافِيَةِ وَفُجَاءَةِ النِّقْمَةِ

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
items.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka al-ʿafwa wal-ʿāfiyata fī ad-dunyā wal-ākhirah. Allāhumma innī as'aluka al-ʿafwa wal-ʿāfiyata fī dīnī wa dunyāyā wa ahli wa mālī.

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth.
translation.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي

virtues.en: Ibn Umar reported that the Prophet ﷺ never abandoned this supplication in the morning and evening. It covers well-being in all aspects of life — asking Allah for pardon and safety in this world, the Hereafter, one’s religion, worldly affairs, family, and wealth.
virtues.ar: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَدَعُ هَؤُلَاءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ حِينَ يُمْسِي وَحِينَ يُصْبِحُ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي

title.en: Seeking Refuge in Allah’s Light from All Darkness and Evil
title.ar: الِاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِنُورِ وَجْهِ اللَّهِ مِنْ كُلِّ ظُلْمَةٍ وَشَرٍّ

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ لَا أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِكَ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu biriḍāka min sakhaṭik, wa bimuʿāfātika min ʿuqūbatik, wa aʿūdhu bika minka, lā uḥṣī thanā'an ʿalayk, anta kamā athnayta ʿalā nafsik.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your anger, and in Your pardon from Your punishment. And I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praises. You are as You have praised Yourself.
translation.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لَا أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ

virtues.en: Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Prophet ﷺ taught her this supplication. It is one of the most profound and beautiful supplications in Islam, expressing the servant’s complete helplessness and need for Allah, and acknowledging the inability to fully praise Allah as He deserves. It is reported in Sahih Muslim.
virtues.ar: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ لَا أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ. رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ

title.en: The Morning Prayer for Guidance, Provision, and Every Good Deed
title.ar: دُعَاءُ الصَّبَاحِ لِلْهِدَايَةِ وَالرِّزْقِ وَكُلِّ عَمَلٍ صَالِحٍ

items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.transliteration: Rabbighfir lī wa tub ʿalayya innaka anta at-tawwābu ar-raḥīm.

translation.en: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance, for indeed You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
translation.ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ

reference.notes: Also reported as hadith of the Prophet’s frequent supplication

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ used to say this frequently, especially after the prayer. Abu Hurairah reported that the Prophet ﷺ would say this after every prayer. This is a Quranic duʿa from the words of Allah, making it especially meritorious. It is reported in Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.
virtues.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يُكْثِرُ أَنْ يَقُولَ: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ. وَهُوَ مِنْ آيَاتِ الْقُرْآنِ الْكَرِيمِ. رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَالتِّرْمِذِيُّ

title.en: The Morning Supplication Asking Allah for Taqwa, Purification, and Guidance
title.ar: دُعَاءُ الصَّبَاحِ بِسُؤَالِ اللَّهِ التَّقْوَى وَالتَّطْهِيرِ وَالرُّشْدِ

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا وَزَكِّهَا أَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا، أَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلَاهَا
items.transliteration: Allāhumma āti nafsī taqwāhā wa zakkīhā, anta khayru man zakkāhā, anta waliyyuhā wa mawlāhā.

translation.en: O Allah, grant my soul its taqwa (consciousness of You) and purify it, for You are the best to purify it. You are its Guardian and its Lord.
translation.ar: اللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا وَزَكِّهَا أَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا، أَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلَاهَا

reference.notes: Combines Quran 91:9 with Prophetic supplication

virtues.en: This is a beautiful supplication combining a Quranic verse (91:9) with a Prophetic duʿa. The Prophet ﷺ used to make this supplication frequently. It asks Allah to grant the soul its consciousness of Him, to purify it, and acknowledges that Allah alone is the best purifier and the ultimate Guardian of the soul.
virtues.ar: دُعَاءٌ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الْآيَةِ الْقُرْآنِيَّةِ وَالدُّعَاءِ النَّبَوِيِّ. كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَقُولُهُ كَثِيرًا وَفِيهِ طَلَبُ التَّقْوَى وَالتَّزْكِيَةِ مِنَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى

title.en: Seeking Morning Refuge in Allah's Perfect Words from Devils, Beasts, and the Evil Eye
title.ar: الِاسْتِعَاذَةُ الصَّبَاحِيَّةُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَالْهَوَامِّ وَالْعَيْنِ

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
items.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bikalimātillāhi at-tāmmati min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmatin, wa min kulli ʿaynin lāmmatin.

translation.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.
translation.ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ used to seek refuge with these words for Hasan and Husayn, saying: "I seek refuge for you both in the perfect words of Allah from every devil, every poisonous creature, and every evil eye." Then he said: "Your father (Ibrahim) used to seek refuge with these words for Isma'il and Ishaq." (Sahih al-Bukhari 3371). This extended wording specifically mentions devils, poisonous creatures, and the evil eye — a more detailed version than the simpler "min sharri ma khalaq."
virtues.ar: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يُعَوِّذُ الْحَسَنَ وَالْحُسَيْنَ وَيَقُولُ: إِنَّ أَبَاكُمَا كَانَ يُعَوِّذُ بِهَا إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ. رَوَاهُ الْبُخَارِيُّ

title.en: Seeking Allah's Forgiveness and Turning to Him in Repentance One Hundred Times
title.ar: الِاسْتِغْفَارُ وَالتَّوْبَةُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ صَبَاحًا

items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullāha wa atūbu ilayh.

translation.en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah and I repent to Him.
translation.ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ used to seek Allah's forgiveness more than seventy times a day. In Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim, it is reported that the Prophet ﷺ said: "By Allah, I seek the forgiveness of Allah and I repent to Him more than seventy times each day." Aga Khumayr reported that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says: I seek the forgiveness of Allah (Astaghfirullāha) one hundred times in the morning, one hundred good deeds will be recorded for him, and one hundred sins will be erased from him." (at-Tabarani, Hasan)
virtues.ar: عَنِ الْأَغَرِّ الْمُزَنِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي وَإِنِّي لَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ. رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ. وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً. مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ

title.en: The Comprehensive Morning Supplication Seeking Allah's Protection from All Harm
title.ar: الدُّعَاءُ الصَّبَاحِيُّ الْجَامِعُ لِلِاسْتِعَاذَةِ مِنْ جَمِيعِ أَنْوَاعِ الضَّرِّ

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَىٰ مُسْلِمٍ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿālima al-ghaybi wash-shahādati, fāṭira as-samāwāti wal-arḍ, rabba kulli shay'in wa malīkah. Ashhadu allā ilāha illā anta. Aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī, wa min sharri ash-shayṭāni wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa ʿalā nafsī sū'an aw ajurrahu ilā muslim.

translation.en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord of everything and its Sovereign. I bear witness that there is no deity except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own soul and from the evil of Shaytan and his association (with Allah), and that I should commit evil against myself or bring it upon a Muslim.
translation.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says in the morning: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen... (the rest of the du'a) — and then dies that day, he will enter Paradise. And whoever says it in the evening and then dies that night, he will enter Paradise." (Sunan Abi Dawud 5069, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3392 — Sahih). This is one of the most comprehensive daily supplications, combining testimony of faith with seeking refuge from every type of evil.
virtues.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ وَحِينَ يُمْسِي: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ بِلِسَانِهِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ ثُمَّ دَعَا اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ. رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَالتِّرْمِذِيُّ

title.en: Seeking Refuge from the Removal of Blessings, Loss of Well-Being, and Sudden Punishment
title.ar: الِاسْتِعَاذَةُ الصَّبَاحِيَّةُ مِنْ زَوَالِ النِّعَمِ وَفُجَاءَةِ النِّقَمِ

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
items.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min zawāli niʿmatika, wa tahawwuli ʿāfiyatika, wa fujā'ati niqmatika, wa jamīʿi sakhaṭik.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the removal of Your blessing, the loss of the well-being that You have granted, the sudden onset of Your punishment, and all of Your displeasure.
translation.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ used to make this supplication seeking refuge from four devastating things: loss of blessings, loss of health, sudden punishment, and all of Allah's anger. It is a powerful reminder of human vulnerability and our complete dependence on Allah's continued grace. (Sahih Muslim 2731)
virtues.ar: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: لَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَدَعُ هَؤُلَاءِ الدَّعَوَاتِ حِينَ يُمْسِي وَحِينَ يُصْبِحُ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ. رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ

title.en: Seeking Morning Refuge in Allah's Words from His Anger, Punishment, and Evil of Creation
title.ar: الِاسْتِعَاذَةُ الصَّبَاحِيَّةُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
items.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bikalimātillāhi at-tāmmati min ghaḍabihī wa ʿiqābih, wa sharri ʿibādih, wa min hamazātish-shayāṭīni wa an yaḥḍurūn.

translation.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger, His punishment, the evil of His servants, and from the whispers of the devils and that they should be present.
translation.ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ

virtues.en: This is a powerful and detailed supplication for seeking refuge in Allah's perfect words. It specifically mentions seeking refuge from Allah's anger and punishment, the evil of His creation, and the approaches of devils. It is reported in Sunan Abi Dawud and other collections with authentic chains. (Sunan Abi Dawud 3891 — Hasan)
virtues.ar: دُعَاءٌ شَامِلٌ لِلِاسْتِعَاذَةِ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ. رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ

title.en: Glorifying Allah and Declaring His Greatness in the Morning

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: Subḥāna Allāhi wa biḥamdih, subḥāna Allāhi al-ʿaẓīm.

translation.en: Glory is to Allah and all praise is due to Him. Glory is to Allah, the Most Great.
translation.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ

virtues.en: Abu Hurairah reported that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Two words are light on the tongue, heavy on the Scales, and beloved to the Most Merciful: Subḥāna Allāhi wa biḥamdih, subḥāna Allāhi al-ʿaẓīm." (Sahih al-Bukhari 6405, Sahih Muslim 2694). This brief yet immensely rewarding dhikr should be part of every Muslim's morning and evening routine.
virtues.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ. مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ

title.en: Asking Allah for Pardon — He Loves to Pardon
title.ar: سُؤَالُ اللَّهِ الْعَفْوَ فَإِنَّهُ يُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
items.transliteration: Allāhumma innaka ʿafuwwun tuḥibbul-ʿafwa faʿfu ʿannī.

translation.en: O Allah, You are the One who pardons, You love to pardon, so pardon me.
translation.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ كَرِيمٌ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي

virtues.en: Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her) asked the Prophet ﷺ: "O Messenger of Allah, if I know which night is the Night of Decree, what should I say during it?" He replied: "Say: O Allah, You are the One who pardons, You love to pardon, so pardon me." (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3513 — Sahih). Though originally for Laylat al-Qadr, the scholars have emphasized its virtue as a daily morning and evening supplication due to its beautiful meaning and authentic chain.
virtues.ar: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ عَلِمْتُ أَيُّ لَيْلَةٍ لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ مَا أَقُولُ فِيهَا؟ قَالَ: قُولِي اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي. رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيُّ

title.en: Declaring No Power or Strength Except with Allah
title.ar: إِثْبَاتُ أَنَّ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ

items.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.

translation.en: There is no power and no strength except with Allah.
translation.ar: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "There is no power and no strength except with Allah is a treasure from the treasures of Paradise." (Sahih al-Bukhari 6409, Sahih Muslim 2694). Abu Hurairah also reported that the Prophet ﷺ said to him: "Say: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah frequently, for it is from the treasures of Paradise." This phrase expresses complete dependence on Allah and is one of the most frequently repeated statements of the Prophet ﷺ.
virtues.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: أَكْثِرْ مِنْ قَوْلِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا كَنْزٌ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ. مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ

title.en: Affirming the Morning upon the Natural Disposition of Islam
title.ar: الْإِقْرَارُ صَبَاحًا بِالْفِطْرَةِ وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَمِلَّةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ

items.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَىٰ فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَىٰ كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَىٰ دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَىٰ مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
items.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā ʿalā fiṭrati al-islām, wa ʿalā kalimati al-ikhlāṣ, wa ʿalā dīni nabīyinā Muḥammadin ﷺ, wa ʿalā millati abīnā Ibrāhīma ḥanīfan musliman wa mā kāna minal-mushrikīn.

translation.en: We have reached the morning upon the natural disposition of Islam, upon the word of sincerity, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, upright and a Muslim, and he was not of the polytheists.
