virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «من قال بعد كل صلاة: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير — غُفرت ذنوبه وإن كانت مثل زبد البحر» — رواه أبو هريرة، صحيح مسلم (597). ومن قالها مائة مرة في اليوم كانت له عدل عشر رقاب، وكُتبت له مائة حسنة، ومُحيت عنه مائة سيئة — صحيح البخاري (6403)، صحيح مسلم (2691).

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
items.transliteration: Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayt, wa la mu'tiya lima mana't, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.

translation.en: O Allah, none can withhold what You have given, and none can give what You have withheld. The wealth of the wealthy does not avail them before You.
translation.ar: اللهم لا مانع لما أعطيت...

reference.notes: Sahih — recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari 844 (Book of Tahajjud); the Prophet's supplication after rising from ruku'. See Hisn al-Muslim for full citation as post-prayer dhikr.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ used to supplicate: 'Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayt, wa la mu'tiya lima mana't, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd' — O Allah, none can withhold what You have given, none can give what You have withheld, and the wealth of the wealthy does not avail before You. (Recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari 844; see Hisn al-Muslim for full citation as post-prayer dhikr.)
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يقول: «اللهم لا مانع لما أعطيت، ولا معطي لما منعت، ولا ينفع ذا الجد منك الجد» — رواه البخاري (844). راجع حصن المسلم للنص الكامل بوصفه ذكراً دبر الصلاة.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa husni 'ibadatik.

translation.en: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best manner.
translation.ar: اللهم أعني على ذكرك وشكرك وحسن عبادتك

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Mu'adh bin Jabal; classed Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 1522.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said to Mu'adh bin Jabal: 'O Mu'adh, by Allah I love you; do not neglect to say at the end of every prayer: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa husni 'ibadatik.' (Narrated by Mu'adh bin Jabal, Sunan Abi Dawud 1522; classed Sahih by Al-Albani.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ لمعاذ بن جبل: «يا معاذ، والله إني لأحبك، فلا تدعن في دبر كل صلاة أن تقول: اللهم أعني على ذكرك وشكرك وحسن عبادتك» — رواه معاذ بن جبل، سنن أبي داود (1522)، صححه الألباني.

items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
items.transliteration: Qul huwa-llahu ahad...

translation.en: Surah Al-Ikhlas — recite 3× after Fajr and Maghrib.
translation.ar: الإخلاص بعد الفجر والمغرب

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Abdullah bin Khubayb; classed Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 1523.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said to Abdullah bin Khubayb: 'Say: Qul huwa-llahu ahad, and the two refuge surahs (Al-Falaq and An-Nas) three times in the morning and evening — they will suffice you against everything.' (Narrated by Abdullah bin Khubayb, Sunan Abi Dawud 1523; classed Sahih by Al-Albani.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ لعبد الله بن خبيب: «قل: قل هو الله أحد، والمعوذتين ثلاث مرات حين تصبح وحين تمسي، تكفيك من كل شيء» — رواه عبد الله بن خبيب، سنن أبي داود (1523)، صححه الألباني.

items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq...

translation.en: Surah Al-Falaq — recite 3× after Fajr and Maghrib.
translation.ar: الفلق بعد الفجر والمغرب

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Abdullah bin Khubayb; classed Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 1523.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Reciting Al-Falaq three times after Fajr and Maghrib suffices one against every evil between morning and evening.' (Narrated by Abdullah bin Khubayb, Sunan Abi Dawud 1523; classed Sahih by Al-Albani.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «من قرأ سورة الفلق ثلاث مرات بعد الفجر والمغرب كفته من كل شر بين الصباح والمساء» — رواه عبد الله بن خبيب، سنن أبي داود (1523)، صححه الألباني.

items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbin-nas...

translation.en: Surah An-Nas — recite 3× after Fajr and Maghrib.
translation.ar: الناس بعد الفجر والمغرب

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Abdullah bin Khubayb; classed Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 1523.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Reciting An-Nas three times after Fajr and Maghrib suffices one against every evil.' (Narrated by Abdullah bin Khubayb, Sunan Abi Dawud 1523; classed Sahih by Al-Albani.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «من قرأ سورة الناس ثلاث مرات بعد الفجر والمغرب كفته من كل شر» — رواه عبد الله بن خبيب، سنن أبي داود (1523)، صححه الألباني.

title.en: Allah is the Source of Peace — The Complete Prayer Dua
title.ar: اللهم أنت السلام ومنك السلام تباركت يا ذا الجلال والإكرام

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma antas-salam wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram.

translation.en: O Allah, You are the Source of Peace and from You comes all peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.
translation.ar: اللهم أنت السلام ومنك السلام تباركت يا ذا الجلال والإكرام

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) would say this directly after completing the prayer. Thawban reported: "Whenever the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) finished his prayer, he would seek forgiveness three times and then say: Allahumma antas-salam..." (Sahih Muslim 591). This supplication affirms that all peace and security ultimately come from Allah alone.
virtues.ar: كان النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم) يقول هذا عقب الصلاة مباشرة (صحيح مسلم 591)

title.en: The Testification of Faith After Prayer

items.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Ashhadu alla ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh. Allahumma inni as'alukal-jannah wa a'udhu bika minan-nar.

translation.en: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and His Messenger. O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.
translation.ar: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له وأشهد أن محمداً عبده ورسوله اللهم إني أسألك الجنة وأعوذ بك من النار

virtues.en: After the Salam, the Prophet (peace be upon him) would immediately say the Shahadah. In a hadith narrated by Mu'adh ibn Jabal, the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "There is no servant who says after every prayer: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah... except that his sins would be forgiven even if they were as much as the foam of the sea." (Sahih Muslim 594)
virtues.ar: كان النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم) يقول الشهادتين عقب السلام. وقال: "من قال بعد كل صلاة لا إله إلا الله وحده... غُفرت ذنوبه وإن كانت مثل زبد البحر" (مسلم 594)

title.en: The Tasbihat — SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar (33-33-34)
title.ar: التسبيحات — سبحان الله والحمد لله والله أكبر (33-33-34)

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (33) الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (33) اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (34)
items.transliteration: Subhanallahi (33x), Alhamdulillahi (33x), Allahu Akbar (34x).

translation.en: Glory is to Allah (33 times), All praise is for Allah (33 times), Allah is the Greatest (34 times).
translation.ar: سبحان الله (33) الحمد لله (33) الله أكبر (34)

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said to the Companions after prayer: "Count on your fingers, for they will be questioned and will speak." And he said: "Whoever counts: SubhanAllah 33 times, Alhamdulillah 33 times, and Allahu Akbar 34 times, that is 100, and these 100 will be a light for him on the Day of Resurrection on the Scales heavier than Mount Uhud, and no sin is recorded on that day except it is expiated." (Sahih Muslim 597). The fingers should be used for counting, not prayer beads (misbahah), as the Prophet (peace be upon him) specifically encouraged counting on the fingers.
virtues.ar: قال النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم): "عدوا على أصابعكم فإنها تستنطق وتُسأل" (مسلم 598). وقال: "من سبّح دبر كل صلاة ثلاثاً وثلاثين وحمد ثلاثاً وثلاثين وكبر أربعاً وثلاثين... كانت مئة على الصراط من نور" (مسلم 597)

items.notes: Count on your fingers. SubhanAllah 33x, Alhamdulillah 33x, Allahu Akbar 34x = 100 total.

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadir. Allahumma la mani`a lima a`tayta wa la mu`tiya lima mana`ta wa la yanfa`u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.

translation.en: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. O Allah, none can prevent what You have given, and none can give what You have prevented, and no wealth or majesty can benefit anyone, as from You is all wealth and majesty.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير اللهم لا مانع لما أعطيت ولا معطي لما منعت ولا ينفع ذا الجد منك الجد

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) would say this after prayer. The phrase "la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd" means that no person's wealth, power, or status can benefit them against the will of Allah, for all true power and wealth belong to Him. This is a powerful reminder of complete dependence on Allah (Sahih al-Bukhari 844, Sahih Muslim 593).
virtues.ar: كان النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم) يقول هذا بعد الصلاة. ومعنى "لا ينفع ذا الجد منك الجد" أن لا ينفع أحداً ماله وجاهه عند الله (البخاري 844، مسلم 593)

title.en: Reciting Surah al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq, and an-Nas After Each Prayer
title.ar: قراءة الإخلاص والفلق والناس بعد كل صلاة

items.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ۜ — قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ۜ — قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Qul huwallahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad. — Qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-`uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad. — Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.

translation.en: Surah al-Ikhlas, Surah al-Falaq, and Surah an-Nas (the Mu'awwidhatayn plus al-Ikhlas).
translation.ar: سورة الإخلاح والفلق والناس

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said to Mu'adh ibn Jabal and Abu Hurairah: "After every prayer, recite: Qul huwallahu ahad, then Qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq, then Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas." (Sunan Abi Dawud 1523, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 2903). In another narration, he said they would be sufficient for him against everything (Sahih al-Bukhari 5023, Sunan Abi Dawud 5081). The Prophet (peace be upon him) also used to blow into his hands and wipe his face and body with them after reciting these surahs.
virtues.ar: قال النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم) لمعاذ بن جبل وأبي هريرة: "بعد كل صلاة اقرأ قل هو الله أحد ثم قل أعوذ برب الفلق ثم قل أعوذ برب الناس" (أبو داود 1523، الترمذي 2903). وقال في رواية أخرى: "تكفيك من كل شيء" (البخاري 5023)

items.notes: Recite all three surahs once after each obligatory prayer.

title.en: Du'a Between the Adhan and Iqamah — The Prayer Will Not Be Rejected
title.ar: الدعاء بين الأذان والإقامة — لا يُرد الدعاء

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَٰذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammah was-salatil-qa'imah, ati Muhammadan wasilata wafadilah, wab'athhu maqaman mahmudan alladhi wa'adtah.

translation.en: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the established prayer, grant Muhammad the Wasilah (a station in Paradise) and the Fadilah (a rank above all creation), and raise him to the praised station which You have promised him.
translation.ar: اللهم رب هذه الدعوة التامة والصلاة القائمة آت محمداً الوسيلة والفضيلة وابعثه مقاماً محموداً الذي وعدته

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "The supplication between the adhan and the iqamah is never rejected." So the Companions asked: "What should we say, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied: "Say: Allahumma rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammah..." (Sunan Abi Dawud 521, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 211, graded Sahih). The Wasilah is the highest station in Paradise, and this dua specifically asks Allah to grant it to the Prophet (peace be upon him).
virtues.ar: قال النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم): "الدعاء بين الأذان والإقامة لا يُرد" فقالوا: ما نقول يا رسول الله؟ قال: "قولوا اللهم رب هذه الدعوة التامة..." (أبو داود 521، الترمذي 211، صحيح)

title.en: Rabbana atina fid-dunya — Asking for Good in Both Worlds After Prayer
title.ar: ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة وقنا عذاب النار

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanah, wafil-akhirati hasanah, wa qina `adhaban-nar.

translation.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.
translation.ar: ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة وقنا عذاب النار

virtues.en: Anas ibn Malik reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) made this dua the most. It is the most comprehensive dua covering all of a person's needs. Ibn Abbas reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) taught them to say this in the tashahhud of every prayer (Sahih al-Bukhari 4522). This dua encompasses everything good — in faith, family, health, wealth, knowledge, and ultimately Paradise.
virtues.ar: قال أنس بن مالك: كان أكثر دعاء النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم): "ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة وقنا عذاب النار". وعلمهم إياه في التشهد (البخاري 4522). وهو أشمل دعاء يجمع كل خير

title.en: The Alternative Tasbihat — SubhanAllah 25x, Alhamdulillah 25x, Allahu Akbar 25x, La ilaha illallah 25x

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (25) الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (25) اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (25) لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ (25)
items.transliteration: Subhanallahi (25x), Alhamdulillahi (25x), Allahu Akbar (25x), La ilaha illallahu (25x).

translation.en: Glory is to Allah (25 times), All praise is for Allah (25 times), Allah is the Greatest (25 times), None has the right to be worshipped except Allah (25 times).
translation.ar: سبحان الله (25) والحمد لله (25) والله أكبر (25) ولا إله إلا الله (25)

virtues.en: Ali ibn Abi Talib (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said after prayer: "Whoever glorifies Allah after every prayer thirty-three times, praises Allah thirty-three times, and magnifies Allah thirty-four times, that is one hundred and five on his tongue, and one thousand and five hundred on the Scale, and one thousand and five hundred sins are expiated." In another authentic narration from Ali, he reported the 25-25-25-25 division as well (Sunan Abi Dawud 1503).
virtues.ar: روى علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه أن النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم) قال بعد الصلاة: "من سبّح الله دبر كل صلاة ثلاثاً وثلاثين وحمد ثلاثاً وثلاثين وكبر أربعاً وثلاثين..." (أبو داود 1503)

items.notes: This is an alternative way of counting. Each phrase 25 times totals 100.

items.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَىٰ دِينِكَ
items.transliteration: Ya muqallibal-qulub, thabbit qalbi `ala dinik.

translation.en: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.
translation.ar: يا مقلب القلوب ثبت قلبي على دينك

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) used to frequently say: "O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion." Umm Salamah said: "O Messenger of Allah, you say this frequently." He said: "No person's heart is safe except that it is between the two fingers of the Most Merciful — He turns it however He wills." (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 2140, graded Hasan Sahih). This shows that after prayer, we should especially ask Allah for steadfastness, as hearts can change at any moment.
virtues.ar: كان النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم) يكثر أن يقول: "يا مقلب القلوب ثبت قلبي على دينك". فقالت أم سلمة: يا رسول الله إنك تكثر من هذا الدعاء. فقال: "إن قلب ابن آدم بين إصبعين من أصابع الرحمن يقلبه كيف يشاء" (الترمذي 2140، حسن صحيح)

title.en: Du'a for Forgiveness in the Tashahhud Position

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا، وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran, wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta, faghfir li maghfiratan min `indik, warhamni innaka antal-ghafurur-rahim.

translation.en: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself, and no one forgives sins except You. So grant me forgiveness from You and have mercy upon me, for indeed You are the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
translation.ar: اللهم إني ظلمت نفسي ظلماً كثيراً ولا يغفر الذنوب إلا أنت فاغفر لي مغفرة من عندك وارحمني إنك أنت الغفور الرحيم

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "No person says, when he is sitting in the tashahhud position: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran... except that his sins — even if they were like the foam of the sea — would be forgiven." (Sahih al-Bukhari 834, Sahih Muslim 2705). This is said while still in the sitting position of the prayer, before the taslim. It is one of the most emphasized supplications within the prayer itself.
virtues.ar: قال النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم): "لا يقعد أحدكم حين يصلي في جلسة التشهد: اللهم إني ظلمت نفسي ظلماً كثيراً... إلا غُفرت له ذنوبه وإن كانت مثل زبد البحر" (البخاري 834، مسلم 2705)

items.notes: This is said in the final sitting (tashahhud) before the taslim.

title.en: Du'a Against Four Trials After Prayer
title.ar: الدعاء من أربع فتن بعد الصلاة

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min `adhabil-qabri, wa min `adhab Jahannam, wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat, wa min sharri fitnatil-masihid-dajjal.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of Hellfire, from the trials of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah (Dajjal).
translation.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من عذاب القبر ومن عذاب جهنم ومن فتنة المحيا والممات ومن شر فتنة المسيح الدجال

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) used to seek refuge from these four things after the tashahhud (Sahih al-Bukhari 832, Sahih Muslim 589). These four represent the greatest trials a believer can face: the punishment in the grave, the punishment of Hell, the tribulations of this life and the agonies of death, and the greatest fitnah — the Dajjal. Seeking refuge from these after every prayer ensures constant protection.
virtues.ar: كان النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم) يستعيذ من هذه الأربع بعد التشهد (البخاري 832، مسلم 589). وهذه الأربع تمثل أعظم الفتن: عذاب القبر وعذاب النار وفتن الحياة والموت وفتنة الدجال

items.notes: This is said in the final sitting (tashahhud) before the taslim.

title.en: Du'a for Good After Prayer — The Prophet's Personal Supplication
title.ar: الدعاء للخير بعد الصلاة — دعاء النبي الشخصي

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhartu, wa ma asrartu wa ma a'lantu, wa ma asraftu wa ma anta a'lamu bihi minni. Antal-muqaddimu wa antal-mu'akhkhiru, la ilaha illa anta.

translation.en: O Allah, forgive me for what I have done in the past and what I will do in the future, what I have concealed and what I have revealed, and what I have exceeded in. You are the One Who brings forward and the One Who delays. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
translation.ar: اللهم اغفر لي ما قدمت وما أخرت وما أسررت وما أعلنت وما أسرفت وما أنت أعلم به مني أنت المقدم وأنت المؤخر لا إله إلا أنت

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) would say this in the tashahhud (Sahih Muslim 2719). It is one of the most comprehensive forms of istighfar, covering all categories of sins: past and future, hidden and open, and even the sins one is unaware of. The phrases "Antal-muqaddimu wa antal-mu'akhkhiru" affirm Allah's complete control over time and all matters.
virtues.ar: كان النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم) يقول هذا في التشهد (مسلم 2719). وهو من أشمل صيغ الاستغفار يغطي كل أنواع الذنوب: الماضي والمستقبل والسر والعلن وما تجاوز فيه العبد وما يجهله من نفسه

items.notes: Said in the final sitting (tashahhud) before the taslim.

title.en: Reciting the Mu'awwidhatayn and Blowing After Prayer

items.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ — قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-`uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad. — Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.

translation.en: Surah al-Falaq and Surah an-Nas (the two seeking-refuge surahs).
translation.ar: سورة الفلق وسورة الناس

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) would recite the Mu'awwidhatayn and then blow onto his hands and wipe them over his face and body. Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her) reported: "When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was ill, he would recite the Mu'awwidhatayn and blow over himself. When his pain increased, I would blow over him and wipe his body with his own hand, seeking its blessing." (Sahih al-Bukhari 5016). After prayer, reciting them and blowing on oneself is a powerful protection.
virtues.ar: كان النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم) يقرأ المعوذتين ثم ينفث في كفيه ويمسح بهما وجهه وجسده. قالت عائشة: "كان إذا اشتكى يقرأ المعوذتين وينفث على نفسه" (البخاري 5016). وتلاوتها بعد الصلاة والنفث على النفس حماية قوية

items.notes: Recite both surahs, then blow into your hands and wipe over your face and body.

title.en: Du'a After the Final Taslim of Fajr and Maghrib

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadir. Allahumma la mani`a lima a`tayta wa la mu`tiya lima mana`ta wa la yanfa`u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.

translation.en: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things omnipotent. O Allah, none can prevent what You have given, and none can give what You have prevented, and no wealth or majesty can benefit anyone, as from You is all wealth and majesty.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له له الملك وله الحمد يحيي ويميت وهو على كل شيء قدير اللهم لا مانع لما أعطيت ولا معطي لما منعت ولا ينفع ذا الجد منك الجد

virtues.en: Abdullah az-Zubayr reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) would say this immediately after the taslim of the Fajr and Maghrib prayers. The phrase "yuhyi wa yumitu" (He gives life and causes death) is specifically added here. This is recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari (844) and Sahih Muslim (593). It is specifically emphasized after these two prayers because they border the night, a time of vulnerability.
virtues.ar: روى عبد الله الزبير أن النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم) كان يقول هذا عقب تسليم الفجر والمغرب (البخاري 844، مسلم 593). وزيد "يحيي ويميت" هنا خصوصاً لأن هاتين الصلاتين تحدان بالليل وهو وقت ضعف

items.notes: This specific version with "yuhyi wa yumitu" is said after Fajr and Maghrib prayers.

title.en: Sending Blessings Upon the Prophet After the Tashahhud

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
items.transliteration: Allahumma salli `ala Muhammadin wa `ala ali Muhammadin kama sallayta `ala Ibrahima wa `ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidun Majid.

translation.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim, indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
translation.ar: اللهم صل على محمد وعلى آل محمد كما صليت على إبراهيم وعلى آل إبراهيم إنك حميد مجيد

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "There is a prayer that if anyone says it, he will have my intercession on the Day of Resurrection." The Companions asked: "What is it?" He said: "O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad..." (Sunan ad-Darimi 2717, graded Hasan). Sending salah upon the Prophet (peace be upon him) after the final tashahhud is obligatory in the Hanafi school and strongly emphasized by all scholars.
virtues.ar: قال النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم): "سألت ربي أن لا يُصلّي عليّ أحد من أمتي إلا رددت عليه عشراً" (الدرامي 2717). والصلاة على النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم) بعد التشهد الأخير واجبة عند الحنفية ومؤكدة عند سائر العلماء

items.notes: Said in the final tashahhud before the taslim. Part of the obligatory prayer.

title.en: Du'a for Beneficial Knowledge After Prayer

items.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi zidni `ilman.

translation.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
translation.ar: رب زدني علماً

virtues.en: This is the dua of Prophet Musa (peace be upon him) in the Quran (20:114). While it can be said at any time, the scholars mention it as a recommended dua after prayer, especially for students of knowledge. Allah commanded His Prophet (peace be upon him) to say: "My Lord, increase me in knowledge." This shows that seeking knowledge is a lifelong journey that never ends. Saying this after prayer connects the act of worship with the desire for more understanding.
virtues.ar: هذا دعاء موسى عليه السلام في القرآن (20:114). والخاصة للطلبة بعد الصلاة. وأمر الله به نبيه أن يقول: "رب زدني علماً" مما يدل على أن طلب العلم رحلة لا تنتهي

items.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
items.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya.

translation.en: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
translation.ar: باسمك اللهم أموت وأحيا

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Hudhayfah bin al-Yaman; paired with the wake-up dua 'Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana...' in the same hadith.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'When you go to bed, say: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya. And when you wake, say: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.' (Narrated by Hudhayfah, Sahih al-Bukhari 6324.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «إذا أخذت مضجعك فقل: باسمك اللهم أموت وأحيا، وإذا أصبحت فقل: الحمد لله الذي أحيانا بعد ما أماتنا وإليه النشور» — رواه حذيفة بن اليمان، صحيح البخاري (6324).

items.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ...
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum...

translation.en: Ayat al-Kursi — recite before sleep.
translation.ar: آية الكرسي عند النوم

reference.notes: Sahih — virtue narrated by Abu Hurairah, Sahih al-Bukhari 2311 (the famous story of the shaytan who came to steal charity).

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'When you go to bed, recite Ayat al-Kursi — a guardian from Allah will remain with you and no Shaytan will approach you until morning.' (Narrated by Abu Hurairah, Sahih al-Bukhari 2311.) This is the famous hadith of Abu Hurairah and the shaytan who came repeatedly to steal from the food of charity.
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «إذا أويت إلى فراشك فاقرأ آية الكرسي، فإنه لن يزال عليك من الله حافظ ولا يقربك شيطان حتى تصبح» — رواه أبو هريرة، صحيح البخاري (2311). وفيه قصة أبي هريرة مع الشيطان الذي جاء يحرس صدقة الصائم.

items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
items.transliteration: Qul huwa-llahu ahad...

translation.en: Surah Al-Ikhlas — recite 3× in palms before sleep, then wipe over body.
translation.ar: الإخلاص عند النوم

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Aisha; the practice of cupping hands, reciting the three Quls, and wiping over the body before sleep.

virtues.en: Aisha reported: 'When the Prophet ﷺ went to bed, he would cup his hands together, recite Qul huwa-llahu ahad, Qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq, and Qul a'udhu bi-rabbin-nas, then wipe whatever he could of his body with them — starting with his head, face, and the front of his body. He did this three times.' (Sahih al-Bukhari 6319.)
virtues.ar: عن عائشة قالت: «كان النبي ﷺ إذا أوى إلى فراشه جمع كفيه ثم نفث فيهما ثم قرأ: قل هو الله أحد، والمعوذتين، ثم يمسح بهما ما استطاع من جسده، يبدأ برأسه ووجهه وما أقبل من جسده، يفعل ذلك ثلاثاً» — صحيح البخاري (6319).

items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq...

translation.en: Surah Al-Falaq — recite 3× in palms before sleep.
translation.ar: الفلق عند النوم

virtues.en: Protection through the night.
virtues.ar: حماية خلال الليل.

items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbin-nas...

translation.en: Surah An-Nas — recite 3× in palms before sleep.
translation.ar: الناس عند النوم

virtues.en: Protection through the night.
virtues.ar: حماية خلال الليل.

items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ ۝ لَا أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ ۝ وَلَا أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ ۝ وَلَا أَنَا عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ ۝ وَلَا أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ ۝ لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِيَ دِينِ
items.transliteration: Qul ya ayyuhal-kafirun. La a'budu ma ta'budun. Wa la antum 'abiduna ma a'bud. Wa la ana 'abidum-ma 'abadtum. Wa la antum 'abiduna ma a'bud. Lakum dinukum wa liya din.

translation.en: Say: O disbelievers, I do not worship what you worship. Nor are you worshippers of what I worship. Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship. Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship. For you is your religion, and for me is my religion.
translation.ar: سورة الكافرون كاملة

reference.narrator: Nawfal ibn Mu'awiyah / Farwah ibn Nawfal
reference.notes: Also narrated in Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3403; graded hasan by al-Albani.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ told a companion: “Recite: Say, O disbelievers, then go to sleep at its end, for it is a disavowal of shirk.” (Sunan Abi Dawud 5055, Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3403.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ لأحد أصحابه: «اقرأ: قل يا أيها الكافرون، ثم نم في آخرها، فإنها براءة من الشرك» — رواه أبو داود (٥٠٥٥) والترمذي (٣٤٠٣).

items.notes: Narrated by Farwah ibn Nawfal, from his father.

items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Tabarakalladhi biyadihil-mulku wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadir… (recite the full 30 ayat)

translation.en: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent — the opening verse of a 30-verse surah recommended for recitation in full each night before sleeping.
translation.ar: تبارك الذي بيده الملك وهو على كل شيء قدير — الآية الأولى من سورة تُقرأ كاملة كل ليلة

reference.book: Book on the Virtues of the Qur'an
reference.notes: Also narrated in Sunan Abi Dawud and graded hasan/sahih by multiple scholars including al-Albani.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: “There is a surah in the Qur'an of thirty verses which will intercede for its companion until he is forgiven: Tabaraka'lladhi bi yadihi'l-mulk.” It is also reported to protect its reciter from the trial and punishment of the grave. Only the opening verse is shown here — please recite the complete surah from the Mushaf or a trusted copy.
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «إن سورة من القرآن ثلاثون آية شفعت لصاحبها حتى غُفر له، وهي سورة تبارك الذي بيده الملك» — رواه الترمذي (٢٨٩٢). يُقرأ هنا مطلعها فقط، ويُستحب قراءتها كاملة من المصحف.

items.notes: Full surah (67:1-30) should be recited from the Mushaf; only the opening verse is reproduced here.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak.

translation.en: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day You resurrect Your servants.
translation.ar: اللهم قني عذابك يوم تبعث عبادك

virtues.en: Recite 3× before sleep.
virtues.ar: تقال ثلاثاً عند النوم.

items.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma wada'tu janbi, wa bika arfa'uh...

translation.en: In Your name, O Allah, I lay my side down, and by Your name I raise it.
translation.ar: باسمك اللهم وضعت جنبي...

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Al-Bara' bin 'Azib.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'When you go to bed, say: Bismika Allahumma wada'tu janbi, wa bika arfa'uh, fa in amsakta nafsi farhamha, wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi 'ibadakas-salihin — if you die that night, you die on the fitrah.' (Narrated by Al-Bara' bin 'Azib, Sahih al-Bukhari 6320.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «إذا أخذت مضجعك فقل: باسمك اللهم وضعت جنبي، وبك أرفعه، فإن أمسكت نفسي فارحمها، وإن أرسلتها فاحفظها بما تحفظ به عبادك الصالحين — فإن متّ متّ على الفطرة» — رواه البراء بن عازب، صحيح البخاري (6320).

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah.

translation.en: Glory be to Allah.
translation.ar: سبحان الله

virtues.en: Part of the 33-33-34 tasbih before sleep. Better than a servant.
virtues.ar: خير لكما من خادم.

items.notes: Narrated by Ali bin Abi Talib.

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah.

translation.en: Praise be to Allah.
translation.ar: الحمد لله

virtues.en: Part of the 33-33-34 tasbih before sleep.
virtues.ar: من تسبيح علي وفاطمة.

items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allahu akbar.

translation.en: Allah is the Greatest.
translation.ar: الله أكبر

virtues.en: Completes 100. If you die that night, you die on fitrah.
virtues.ar: من قالهن قبل النوم فمات مات على الفطرة.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk...

translation.en: O Allah, I have submitted my soul to You, entrusted my affairs to You, turned my face to You...
translation.ar: اللهم أسلمت نفسي إليك...

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Al-Bara' bin 'Azib; the comprehensive bedtime dua to be said after performing wudu and lying on the right side.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'When you go to your bed, perform wudu as for prayer, then lie on your right side and say: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk... Make these the last words you say.' (Narrated by Al-Bara' bin 'Azib, Sahih al-Bukhari 6313.) If you die that night, you die on the fitrah.
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «إذا أخذت مضجعك فتوضأ وضوءك للصلاة، ثم اضطجع على شقك الأيمن، ثم قل: اللهم أسلمت نفسي إليك، وفوضت أمري إليك، ووجّهت وجهي إليك... واجعلهن آخر ما تقول» — رواه البراء بن عازب، صحيح البخاري (6313). فإن متّ من ليلتك متّ على الفطرة.

items.arabic: Tabarakalladhi biyadihil mulku wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Alladhi khalaqal mawta wal-hayata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu 'amala wa huwal 'azeezul ghafur... [Full Surah al-Mulk - 30 verses]
items.transliteration: Tabarakalladhi biyadihil mulku wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir...

translation.en: Blessed is He in whose hand is the dominion, and He is over all things competent. [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving... [Full Surah al-Mulk - 30 verses]
translation.ar: تبارك الذي بيده الملك وهو على كل شيء قدير...

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: “There is a surah in the Quran that is thirty ayat which interceded for a man until he was forgiven. It is Surah Tabarakalladhi biyadihil mulk (Surah al-Mulk).” Narrated by Abu Hurairah. This surah is known as 'Al-Mani'ah' (the protector) and 'Al-Munjiyah' (the savior) because it protects its reciter from the torment of the grave.
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: “إن سورة من القرآن ثلاثون آية شفعت لرجل حتى غُفر له، وهي سورة تبارك الذي بيده الملك” رواه أبو هريرة

items.arabic: Qul ya ayyuhal-kafirun. La a'budu ma ta'budun. Wa la antum 'abiduna ma a'bud. Wa la ana 'abidun ma 'abadtum. Wa la antum 'abiduna ma a'bud. Lakum deenukum waliya deen.
items.transliteration: Qul ya ayyuhal-kafirun. La a'budu ma ta'budun...

translation.en: Say, “O disbelievers, I do not worship what you worship. Nor are you worshippers of what I worship... For you is your religion, and for me is my religion.”
translation.ar: قل يا أيها الكافرون لا أعبد ما تعبدون...

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: “Reciting Surah al-Kafirun is equivalent to reciting a quarter of the Quran.” (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 2894). It is a complete declaration of pure monotheism.
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: “قراءة سورة الكافرون تعدل ربع القرآن”

title.en: Surah al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq, an-Nas — The Three Quls

items.arabic: Qul huwal-lahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yoolad. Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad. / Qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. / Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas.
items.transliteration: Qul huwal-lahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yoolad. Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad. Qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas.

translation.en: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. / Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak. / Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind.
translation.ar: قل هو الله أحد. الله الصمد. لم يلد ولم يولد. ولم يكن له كفوا أحد. / قل أعوذ برب الفلق. / قل أعوذ برب الناس.

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said to Aisha: “When you go to your bed, recite Surah al-Ikhlas, Surah al-Falaq, and Surah an-Nas, then blow into your palms and wipe them over whatever you can of your body.” (Sahih al-Bukhari 5017). Al-Ikhlas equals one-third of the Quran (Sahih al-Bukhari 6627).
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ لعائشة: “إذا أويت إلى فراشك فاقرئي سورة الإخلاص والفلق والناس، ثم نفثي في كفيك ومسحي بهما ما استطعت” متفق عليه

items.notes: Recite each surah 3 times, then blow into your hands and wipe over your body.

items.arabic: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum. La ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-ithnih. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum. Wa la yuheetoona bishay'in min 'ilmihii illa bima sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard. Wa la ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma. Wa huwal-'aliyyul-'azeem.
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum...

translation.en: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence...
translation.ar: الله لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم...

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: “When you go to your bed, recite Ayat al-Kursi, for there will remain with you a guardian from Allah, and no devil will approach you until the morning.” (Sahih al-Bukhari 2311).
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: “إذا أويت إلى فراشك فاقرأ آية الكرسي” (البخاري 2311)

title.en: Last Two Ayahs of Surah al-Baqarah

items.arabic: Amanar-rasulu bima unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal-mu'minun. Kullun amana billahi wa mala'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi la nafarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulihi wa qalu sami'na wa ata'na ghufiranaka rabbana wa ilaykal-masir. La yukallifullahu nafsan illa wus'aha...
items.transliteration: Amanar-rasulu bima unzila ilayhi min rabbihi...

translation.en: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers... Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred...
translation.ar: آمن الرسول بما أنزل إليه من ربه...

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: “Whoever recites the last two ayahs of Surah al-Baqarah at night, they will be sufficient for him.” (Sahih al-Bukhari 5008).
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: “من قرأ بالآيتين من آخر سورة البقرة في ليلة كفتاه” (البخاري 5008)

title.en: In Your Name I Die and I Live

items.arabic: Bismikallahumma amutu wa ahya.
items.transliteration: Bismikallahumma amutu wa ahya.

translation.en: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
translation.ar: باسمك اللهم أموت وأحيا

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) used to say when going to sleep: “Bismikallahumma amutu wa ahya.” (Sahih al-Bukhari 6954).
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ إذا أوى إلى فراشه قال: “باسمك اللهم أموت وأحيا”

title.en: Seeking Refuge from the Punishment of the Grave

items.arabic: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak.
items.transliteration: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak.

translation.en: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
translation.ar: اللهم قني عذابك يوم تبعث عبادك

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) taught this supplication to be recited before sleeping. (Sunan Abi Dawud 5045).
virtues.ar: علم النبي ﷺ هذا الدعاء عند النوم (أبو داود 5045)

items.arabic: Allahumma rabba as-samawati wa rabba al-ardi wa rabba al-'arshil-'azeem, rabbana wa rabba kulli shay', faliqal-habbi wan-nawa, wa munzilat-tawrati wal-injeeli wal-furqan, a'udhu bika min sharri kulli shay'in anta akhidhun bina-siyatih. Allahumma antal-awwalu fa laysa qablaka shay', wa antal-akhiru fa laysa ba'daka shay', wa antaz-zahiru fa laysa fawqaka shay', wa antal-batinu fa laysa dunaka shay', iqdi 'annid-dayna wa aghnini minal-faqr.
items.transliteration: Allahumma rabba as-samawati...

translation.en: O Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth and Lord of the Noble Throne... O Allah, You are the First, the Last, the Manifest, the Hidden. Settle my debt for me and spare me from poverty.
translation.ar: اللهم رب السماوات ورب الأرض ورب العرش العظيم...

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) would place his hand under his cheek and recite this comprehensive supplication. (Sahih Muslim 2713).
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يضع يده تحت خده ويقرأ هذا الدعاء الشامل (مسلم 2713)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ ﴿١﴾ لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ ﴿٢﴾ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَآ أَنَاۦ عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ ﴿٤﴾ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ ﴿٥﴾ لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ ﴿٦﴾
items.transliteration: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem. Qul yaa ayyuhal-kaafiroon. La a'budu ma ta'budoon. Wa la antum 'aabidoona ma a'bud. Wa la ana 'abidun ma 'abadtum. Wa la antum 'aabidoona ma a'bud. Lakum deenukum wa liya deen.

translation.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: "O disbelievers, I do not worship what you worship. Nor are you worshippers of what I worship. Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship. Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship. For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
translation.ar: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم. قل يا أيها الكافرون. لا أعبد ما تعبدون. ولا أنتم عابدون ما أعبد. ولا أنا عابد ما عبدتم. ولا أنتم عابدون ما أعبد. لكم دينكم ولي دين.

reference.notes: Tirmidhi 2894 (Hasan)

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Reciting Surah al-Kafirun is equivalent to reciting a quarter of the Quran." (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 2894). It is a complete declaration of pure monotheism (Tawheed) and serves as a spiritual shield before sleep, dissociating the believer from shirk in all its forms. Reciting it before sleeping protects one from associating partners with Allah even in their rest.
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: "إن قراءة سورة الكافرون تعدل ربع القرآن" (الترمذي ٢٨٩٤). هي إعلان كامل للتوحيد الخالص ودرع روحي قبل النوم يفصل المؤمن عن الشرك بكل أشكاله.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ﴿١﴾ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ ﴿٢﴾ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ ﴿٣﴾ ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ ﴿٤﴾ وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ﴿٥﴾ وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ﴿٦﴾ إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ ﴿٧﴾ تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ ﴿٨﴾ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ كَبِيرٍ ﴿٩﴾ وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ﴿١٠﴾ فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ﴿١١﴾ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ ﴿١٢﴾ وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ ﴿١٣﴾ أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ ﴿١٤﴾ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ ﴿١٥﴾ ءَأَمْنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ ﴿١٦﴾ أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ ﴿١٧﴾ وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ ﴿١٨﴾ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰفَّٰتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ بَصِيرٌ ﴿١٩﴾ أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ ﴿٢٠﴾ أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ ﴿٢١﴾ أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ ﴿٢٢﴾ قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ ﴿٢٣﴾ قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ ﴿٢٤﴾ وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَ ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ ﴿٢٥﴾ قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۟ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ ﴿٢٦﴾ فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِئَتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ ﴿٢٧﴾ قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ ﴿٢٨﴾ قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ ﴿٢٩﴾ قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَاؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍ ﴿٣٠﴾
items.transliteration: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem. Tabarakalladhee biyadihil mulku wa huwa ala kulli shay-in qadeer. Alladhee khalaqal mawta wal-hayata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu amalan wa huwal-azeezul ghafoor. Alladhee khalaqa sab-a samawatin tibaqan. Ma tara fee khalqir-Rahmani min tafawut. Farji-il-basara hal tara min futoor. Thummar-ji-il-basara karratayn yanqalibu ilaykal-basaru khasi-an wa huwa haseer. Wa laqad zayyannas-sama-ad-dunya bimasabeeha wa ja-alnaha rujuman lish-shayateen. Wa a-tadna lahum adhabas-sa-eer. Wa lilladheena kafaroo bi-rabbihim adhabu jahannama wa bi-sal-maseer. Iza ulqoo feeha sami-oo laha shaheeqan wa hiya tafeer. Takadu tamayyazu minal-ghayz. Kullama ulqiya feeha fawjun sa-alahum khazanatuha a-lam ya-tikum nadheer. Qaloo bala qad ja-ana nadheerun fa-kadhdhabna wa qulna ma nazzalallahu min shay-in. In antum illa fee dalalin kabeer. Wa qaloo law kunna nasma-u aw na-qilu ma kunna fi as-habis-sa-eer. Fa-terafoo bidhambihim fasuhqan li-as-habis-sa-eer. Inna lladheena yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratun wa ajrun kabeer. Wa asirroo qawlakum aw ijharoo bihi. Innahu aleemun bidhatis-sudoor. Ala ya-lamu man khalaqa wa huwal-lateeful-khabeer. Huwalladhee ja-ala lakumul-arda dhaloolan famshoo fee manakibiha wa kuloo min rizqihi wa ilayhin-nushoor. A-amintum man fis-sama-i an yakhsifa bikumul-arda fa-itha hiya tamoor. Am a-mintum man fis-sama-i an yursila alaykum hasiban. Fa-sata-lamuna kayfa nadheer. Wa laqad kadhdhaba lladheena min qablihim fa-kayfa kana nakeer. Awalam yaraw ilat-tayri fawqahum saffatin wa yaqbidna. Ma yumsikuhunna illar-Rahman. Innahu bi-kulli shay-in baseer. A-man hadhalladhee huwa jundun lakum yansurukum min doonir-Rahman. Inil-kaafiroona illa fee ghuroor. A-man hadhalladhee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqahu. Bal lajjoo fee utuwwin wa nufoor. Afaman yamshee mukibban ala wajhihi ahda aw man yamshee sawiyyan ala siratin mustaqeem. Qul huwalladhee ansha-akum wa ja-ala lakumas-sam-a wal-absara wal-af-idah. Qaleelan ma tashkuroon. Qul huwalladhee dhara-akum fil-ardi wa ilayhi tuhsharoon. Wa yaquloona mata hazal-wa-du in kuntum sadiqeen. Qul innamal-ilmu indallahi wa innama ana nadheerun mubeen. Fa-lamma ra-awhu zulfatan si-at wujuhul-ladheena kafaroo wa qeela hazalladhee kuntum bihi tadda-oon. Qul a-ra-aytum in ahlakanillahu wa man ma-iya aw rahimana fa-man yujeerul-kaafireena min adhabin aleem. Qul huwar-Rahmanu aamanna bihi wa alayhi tawakkalna fasata-lamuna man huwa fee dalalin mubeen. Qul a-ra-aytum in asbaha ma-ukum gawran fa-man ya-teekum bi-ma-in maeen.

translation.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Blessed is He in whose hand is the dominion, and He is over all things competent. [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving. [He] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any fractures? Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued. And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze. And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination. When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a dismal breath as it boils up. It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?" They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, "Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error."" And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze." And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze. Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward. And whether you keep your speech hidden or manifest it, surely He has full knowledge of what is in the breasts. Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted? It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection. Do you feel secure that He who is in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway? Or do you feel secure that He who is in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning. And already those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach. Have they not looked at the birds above them, spreading their wings and folding [them]? None holds them up except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing. Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion. Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion. So is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks upright on a straight path? Say, "It is He who produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful." Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered." And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?" Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner." But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieved will be saddened, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call." Say, "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who could protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?" Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error." Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
translation.ar: تبارك الذي بيده الملك وهو على كل شيء قدير. الذي خلق الموت والحياة ليبلوكم أيكم أحسن عملا وهو العزيز الغفور. الذي خلق سبع سماوات طباقا. إلى آخر السورة.

reference.notes: Tirmidhi 2890, 2888

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "There is a surah in the Quran of thirty ayat which interceded for a man until he was forgiven. It is Surah Tabarakalladhi biyadihil mulk (Surah al-Mulk)." (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 2890, graded Sahih by Al-Albani). It is also known as "Al-Mani'ah" (the protector) and "Al-Munjiyah" (the savior) because it protects its reciter from the torment of the grave. The Prophet (peace be upon him) would not sleep until he had recited Surah al-Mulk and Surah as-Sajdah (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 2888).
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: "إن سورة من القرآن ثلاثون آية شفعت لرجل حتى غُفر له، وهي سورة تبارك الذي بيده الملك" (الترمذي ٢٨٩٠). تُعرف أيضاً بالمانعة والمنجية لأنها تحمي قارئها من عذاب القبر. كان النبي ﷺ لا ينام حتى يقرأ سورة الملك وسورة السجدة (الترمذي ٢٨٨٨).

items.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ﴿٤﴾
items.transliteration: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem. Qul huwal-lahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yoolad. Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad.

translation.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: "He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
translation.ar: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم. قل هو الله أحد. الله الصمد. لم يلد ولم يولد. ولم يكن له كفوا أحد.

reference.notes: Bukhari 6627, 5017

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Reciting Surah al-Ikhlas is equivalent to reciting one-third of the Quran." (Sahih al-Bukhari 6627). When combined with Surah al-Falaq and Surah an-Nas and blown upon the body before sleep, no harm can approach the reciter. The Prophet (peace be upon him) instructed Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her) to recite it along with the other two Quls before sleeping. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5017).
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: "إن قراءة سورة الإخلاص تعدل ثلث القرآن" (البخاري ٦٦٢٧). وإذا قُرئت مع سورتي الفلق والناس ونُفخ بها على الجسد قبل النوم لم يَقرب قارئها أي أذى. أمر النبي ﷺ عائشة رضي الله عنها بقراءتها مع المعوذتين قبل النوم (البخاري ٥٠١٧).

items.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾
items.transliteration: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem. Qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.

translation.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak. From the evil of that which He created. And from the evil of darkness when it settles. And from the evil of the blowers in knots. And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
translation.ar: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم. قل أعوذ برب الفلق. من شر ما خلق. ومن شر غاسق إذا وقب. ومن شر النفاثات في العقد. ومن شر حاسد إذا حسد.

reference.notes: Bukhari 5017

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said to Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her): "When you go to your bed, recite Surah al-Ikhlas, Surah al-Falaq, and Surah an-Nas, then blow into your palms and wipe them over whatever you can of your body." (Sahih al-Bukhari 5017). Surah al-Falaq specifically seeks protection from external evils including dark magic, the evil of creation, and the harm of the envious.
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ لعائشة رضي الله عنها: "إذا أويت إلى فراشك فاقرئي سورة الإخلاص والفلق والناس، ثم نفثي في كفيك ومسحي بهما ما استطعت" (البخاري ٥٠١٧). سورة الفلق تطلب الحماية من الشرور الخارجية بما في ذلك السحر والنفاثات في العقد.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾
items.transliteration: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem. Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.

translation.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind. The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind. From the evil of the retreating whisperer. Who whispers [evil] in the breasts of mankind. From among the jinn and mankind."
translation.ar: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم. قل أعوذ برب الناس. ملك الناس. إله الناس. من شر الوسواس الخناس. الذي يوسوس في صدور الناس. من الجنة والناس.

reference.notes: Bukhari 5017

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said to Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her): "When you go to your bed, recite Surah al-Ikhlas, Surah al-Falaq, and Surah an-Nas, then blow into your palms and wipe them over whatever you can of your body." (Sahih al-Bukhari 5017). Surah an-Nas specifically seeks protection from the whisperings of Shaytan, both from among jinn and mankind, making it essential for spiritual safety during the vulnerability of sleep.
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ لعائشة رضي الله عنها: "إذا أويت إلى فراشك فاقرئي سورة الإخلاص والفلق والناس، ثم نفثي في كفيك ومسحي بهما ما استطعت" (البخاري ٥٠١٧). سورة الناس تطلب الحماية من وساوس الشيطان من الجن والإنس مما يجعلها ضرورية للأمان الروحي أثناء نوم العبد.

title.en: Last Two Verses of Surah al-Baqarah (Full) — Before Sleep
title.ar: آيتا خاتمة سورة البقرة (كاملتان) — قبل النوم

items.arabic: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ﴿٢٨٥﴾ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا ۖ وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ۖ وَٱرْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ ﴿٢٨٦﴾
items.transliteration: Amanar-rasulu bima unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal-mu-minoon. Kullun amana billahi wa mala-ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi. La nafarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulihi. Wa qaloo sami-na wa ata-na. Ghufiranaka rabbana wa ilaykal-maseer. La yukallifullahu nafsan illa wus-aha. Laha ma kasabat wa alayha maktasabat. Rabbana la tu-akhidhna in naseena aw akhta-na. Rabbana wa la tahmil alayna isran kama hamaltahu alalladheena min qablina. Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bihi. Wa-afu anna. Waghfir lana. Warhamna. Anta maulana fansurna alal-qawmil-kafireen.

translation.en: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination." Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
translation.ar: آمن الرسول بما أنزل إليه من ربه والمؤمنون. كل آمن بالله وملائكته وكتبه ورسله لا نفرق بين أحد من رسله. وقالوا سمعنا وأطعنا. غفرانك ربنا وإليك المصير. لا يكلف الله نفسا إلا وسعها. لها ما كسبت وعليها ما اكتسبت. ربنا لا تؤاخذنا إن نسينا أو أخطأنا. ربنا ولا تحمل علينا إصرا كما حملته على الذين من قبلنا. ربنا ولا تحملنا ما لا طاقة لنا به. واعف عنا. واغفر لنا. وارحمنا. أنت مولانا فانصرنا على القوم الكافرين.

reference.notes: Bukhari 5008, Muslim 807

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah al-Baqarah at night, they will be sufficient for him." (Sahih al-Bukhari 5008). In another narration from Sahih Muslim 807, Ibn Mas-ud reported that the Prophet said these two verses are sufficient even if one does not recite anything else at night. These verses were given to the Prophet from beneath the Throne, and they were not given to any prophet before him. They encompass belief in all of Allah-s revelations, a comprehensive prayer for forgiveness, and a plea for Allah-s mercy and help.
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: "من قرأ بالآيتين من آخر سورة البقرة في ليلة كفتاه" (البخاري ٥٠٠٨). وفي رواية مسلم ٨٠٧ أن ابن مسعود قال: إن النبي ﷺ قال إنهما كافيتان من لم يقرأ بهما من الليل شيئاً. أُعطيتا النبي ﷺ من تحت العرش ولم تُعطيا نبياً قبله. تشملان الإيمان بجميع وحي الله ودعاء شامل للمغفرة والتوكل على الله.

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and to Him is the resurrection.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: When one of you wakes up, let him say this. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6312). Waking up is a second chance at life, and this dua expresses gratitude for every new morning.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm.

translation.en: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever recites Ayatul Kursi when going to bed, there will remain a guardian from Allah over him, and no devil will approach him until morning. (Sahih al-Bukhari 2311).

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma'asmashi shay-un fil-ardi wa la fis-samai wa huwas-sami'ul-aleem.

translation.en: In the name of Allah, with Whose name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

virtues.en: The Prophet told Abu Bakr: Recite these and then blow on your palms and wipe over your body before sleeping. (Sahih al-Bukhari 3311). It is the most comprehensive prophetic protection for the night.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَىٰ وَمُنزِّلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma Rabbas-samawatis-sab'i wa Rabbal-arshil-azeem Rabbana wa Rabbakulli shay-in faliqal-habbi wan-nawa wa munazzilat-tawrati wal-injeeli wal-furqan a'udhu bika min sharri kulli shay-in anta akhidhun binasiyatihi.

translation.en: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Noble Throne, our Lord and Lord of everything, Splitter of the seed and the kernel, Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Criterion, I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything You hold by its forelock.

virtues.en: The Prophet would recite this long dua before sleeping. (Sahih Muslim 2713). It invokes Allah by His greatest attributes and names, seeking comprehensive protection from all evil throughout the night.

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.

translation.en: Praise be to Allah Who gave us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
translation.ar: الحمد لله الذي أحيانا بعد ما أماتنا وإليه النشور

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Hudhayfah bin al-Yaman; the morning counterpart of the bedtime dua 'Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya' in the same hadith.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'When you go to bed, say: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya. And when you wake, say: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.' (Narrated by Hudhayfah, Sahih al-Bukhari 6324.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «إذا أخذت مضجعك فقل: باسمك اللهم أموت وأحيا، وإذا أصبحت فقل: الحمد لله الذي أحيانا بعد ما أماتنا وإليه النشور» — رواه حذيفة بن اليمان، صحيح البخاري (6324).

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.

translation.en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas; classed Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih at-Tirmidhi 3505.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'The supplication of my brother Yunus, son of Matta: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin. No Muslim ever supplicates with it for anything except that Allah responds.' (Narrated by Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3505; classed Sahih by Al-Albani.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «دعوة أخي يونس بن متى: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين، فما دعا بها مسلم في شيء قط إلا استجاب الله له» — رواه سعد بن أبي وقاص، سنن الترمذي (3505)، صححه الألباني.

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi 'afani fi jasadi, wa radda 'alayya ruhi, wa adhina li bi-dhikrih.

translation.en: Praise be to Allah Who has given me health in my body, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.
translation.ar: الحمد لله الذي عافاني في جسدي ورد علي روحي وأذن لي بذكره

virtues.en: Recited upon waking up.
virtues.ar: تقال عند الاستيقاظ.

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah.

translation.en: Glory be to Allah.
translation.ar: سبحان الله

virtues.en: Whoever recites these before sleep and upon waking and dies, dies on fitrah.
virtues.ar: من قالهن فمات مات على الفطرة.

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah.

translation.en: Praise be to Allah.
translation.ar: الحمد لله

virtues.en: Part of the 33-33-34 upon waking.
virtues.ar: من التسبيح عند الاستيقاظ.

items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allahu akbar.

translation.en: Allah is the Greatest.
translation.ar: الله أكبر

virtues.en: Completes 100. Same as before sleep.
virtues.ar: تمام المائة.

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa-llahu wahdahu la sharika lah...

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah alone... Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no deity except Allah, Allah is Greatest, and there is no power and no strength except by Allah. My Lord, forgive me.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده...

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Ubada bin as-Samit; the comprehensive dhikr for one who wakes during the night.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever wakes at night and says: La ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir — SubhanAllah, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illa Allah, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah — then says: Rabbi-ghfir li (My Lord, forgive me) — Allah will accept his prayer; and if he makes wudu and prays, his prayer will be accepted.' (Narrated by Ubada bin as-Samit, Sahih al-Bukhari 1154.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «من تعارّ من الليل فقال: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير، سبحان الله، والحمد لله، ولا إله إلا الله، والله أكبر، ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله، ثم قال: اللهم اغفر لي — غُفر له. وإن دعا استُجيب له، وإن توضأ وصلى قُبلت صلاته» — رواه عبادة بن الصامت، صحيح البخاري (1154).

title.en: Thanking Allah for Health and Safety Upon Waking
title.ar: الحمد لله الذي عافاني في جسدي

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahilladhi 'afani fi jasadi wa radda 'alayya ruhi wa adhina li bidhikrih.

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who has given my body health, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.
translation.ar: الحمد لله الذي عافاني في جسدي ورد علي روحي وأذن لي بذكره

virtues.en: This beautiful supplication encompasses three blessings: physical health, the return of the soul (from sleep), and the ability to remember Allah. These are among the greatest blessings that many people take for granted. The Prophet (peace be upon him) taught us to immediately thank Allah for these upon waking.
virtues.ar: يشمل هذا الدعاء ثلاث نعم: صحة الجسد وعودة الروح والإذن بذكر الله وهي من أعظم النعم

title.en: Waking Up at Night for Tahajjud

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، أَوْ يُصَلِّي فَتُقْبَلُ صَلَاتُهُ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Subhanallahi wal-hamdu lillahi wa la ilaha illallahu wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. Thumma yaqul: Allahummaghfir li, aw yusalli fa-tuqabalu salatuh.

translation.en: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. Glory is to Allah, all praise is for Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest. There is no power and no might except with Allah. Then one says: O Allah, forgive me. Or one prays, and their prayer is accepted.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير سبحان الله والحمد لله ولا إله إلا الله والله أكبر ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله ثم يقول اللهم اغفر لي أو يصلي فتقبل صلاته

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever wakes up at night and says: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu... then makes dua, his dua will be answered. And whoever performs wudu and prays, his prayer will be accepted." (Sahih al-Bukhari 1154). This is one of the most comprehensive wake-up supplications, combining the four pillars of dhikr with a direct call for forgiveness.
virtues.ar: قال النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم): "من تعار من الليل فقال لا إله إلا الله وحده... ثم دعا استجيب له ومن توضأ وصلى قبلت صلاته"

title.en: Seeking Protection Upon Waking with the Morning Dua

items.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَٰذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَٰذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
items.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa khayra ma ba'dah, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa sharri ma ba'dah.

translation.en: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it.
translation.ar: أصبحنا وأصبح الملك لله والحمد لله لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير رب أسألك خير ما في هذا اليوم وخير ما بعده وأعوذ بك من شر ما في هذا اليوم وشر ما بعده

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) taught this comprehensive morning supplication that begins by acknowledging Allah's complete sovereignty, then asks for all good in the day and protection from all evil. It should be one of the first things said upon waking. A similar version exists for the evening (amsayna).
virtues.ar: علم النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم) هذا الدعاء الشامل الذي يبدأ بالإقرار بملك الله ثم يسأل الخير ويستعيذ من الشر

title.en: Waking Up in Fright — Seeking Refuge in Allah from Shaytan
title.ar: الاستيقاظ فزعاً — التعوذ بالله من الشيطان

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
items.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim.

translation.en: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shaytan.
translation.ar: أعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "If one of you wakes up frightened from a dream, let him spit (dryly) to his left three times and seek refuge in Allah from Shaytan, and it will not harm him." (Sahih al-Bukhari 3318, Sahih Muslim 2262). If one wakes up in a state of fear or alarm, this should be one of the first things said. The Prophet (peace be upon him) also taught that bad dreams are from Shaytan and should be dispelled this way.
virtues.ar: قال النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم): "إذا رأى أحدكم رؤيا يكرهها فليتفل عن يساره ثلاثاً وليتعوذ بالله من الشيطان فإنها لا تضره" (البخاري 3318، مسلم 2262)

title.en: Praising Allah Upon Waking with the Four Praises
title.ar: تمجيد الله عند الاستيقاظ بأربع تكبيرات

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ وَصَلَاتِهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahilladhi 'afani fi jasadi wa radda 'alayya ruhi wa adhina li bidhikrihi wa salatihi.

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who has given my body health, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him and pray to Him.
translation.ar: الحمد لله الذي عافاني في جسدي ورد علي روحي وأذن لي بذكره وصلاته

virtues.en: This is an extended version of the wake-up dua reported in Sunan at-Tirmidhi (3401), adding "and permitted me to pray to Him." This version includes the blessing of being able to perform salah, which is the greatest act of worship. The addition highlights that among the greatest blessings of waking up is the ability to stand before Allah in prayer.
virtues.ar: هذه صيغة موسعة من دعاء الاستيقاظ في سنن الترمذي (3401) بزيادة "وأذن لي بصلاته" وهي تضيف نعمة الصلاة وهي أعظم العبادات

title.en: Reciting the Last Ten Verses of Surah Al Imran Upon Waking
title.ar: تلاوة آخر آل عمران عند الاستيقاظ

items.arabic: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَنْ تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْصَارٍ رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدْتَنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
items.transliteration: Inna fi khalqis-samawati wal-ardi wakhtilafil-layli wan-nahari la-ayatim li-ulil-albab. Alladhina yadhkurunallaha qiyaman wa qu'udan wa 'ala junubihim wa yatafakkaruna fi khalqis-samawati wal-ard. Rabbana ma khalaqta hadha batilan, subhanaka fa-qina 'adhaban-nar. Rabbana innaka man tudkhilin-nara fa-qad akhzaytah, wa ma liz-zalimina min ansar. Rabbana innana sami'na munadiyan yunadi lil-imani an aminu birabbikum fa-amanna. Rabbana faghfir lana dhunubana wa kaffir 'anna sayyi'atina wa tawaffana ma'al-abrar. Rabbana wa atina ma wa'adtana 'ala rusulika wa la tukhzina yawmal-qiyamah, innaka la tukhliful-mi'ad.
