translation.en: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding... (3:190-200)
translation.ar: إن في خلق السماوات والأرض واختلاف الليل والنهار لآيات لأولي الألباب... (3:190-200)

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever recites the last ten verses of Surah Al Imran at night, it will be sufficient for him." (Sahih al-Bukhari 5051). This recitation upon waking is a means of having the entire night and day covered with blessings. These verses contain a comprehensive supplication that the believers make after reflecting on Allah's signs in creation.
virtues.ar: قال النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم): "من قرأ آخر آل عمران في ليلة كُتب له قيام ليلة" (البخاري 5051). وتلاوتها عند الاستيقاظ تغطي الليل والنهار بالبركة

items.notes: Recite the last ten verses of Surah Al Imran (3:190-200).

title.en: The Evening Version Upon Waking Late in the Night

items.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
items.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhihil-laylati wa khayra ma ba'daha, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhihil-laylati wa sharri ma ba'daha.

translation.en: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it.
translation.ar: أمسينا وأمسى الملك لله والحمد لله لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير رب أسألك خير ما في هذه الليلة وخير ما بعدها وأعوذ بك من شر ما في هذه الليلة وشر ما بعدها

virtues.en: This is the night/evening counterpart of the morning dua. The Prophet (peace be upon him) taught Abdullah ibn Mas'ud to say it and said: "Whoever says it in the evening, it will be preserved for him." (Sahih Muslim 2722). If one wakes up during the night, they should use this evening version rather than the morning one.
virtues.ar: هذه هي الصيغة المسائية المقابلة لدعاء الصباح. قال النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم) لعبد الله بن مسعود: "من قالها أمسى أُجير منها" (مسلم 2722). وإذا استيقظ في الليل يقال بهذه الصيغة

title.en: Du'a Upon Waking: O Allah, Forgive Me

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
items.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li.

translation.en: O Allah, forgive me.
translation.ar: اللهم اغفر لي

virtues.en: As part of the comprehensive night-waking supplication, the Prophet (peace be upon him) taught that after saying the four praises (SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illallah, Allahu Akbar, and La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah), one should say: "O Allah, forgive me." (Sahih al-Bukhari 1154). The first thing a believer should seek upon waking is Allah's forgiveness, recognizing that every new day requires a fresh start with Allah.
virtues.ar: كجزء من دعاء الاستيقاظ الليلي الشامل، علّم النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم) أن يُقال بعد الأربع تكبيرات: "اللهم اغفر لي" (البخاري 1154). أول ما يطلبه المؤمن عند الاستيقاظ هو مغفرة الله

title.en: Waking Before Fajr — Seeking Allah's Blessing for the Remaining Night
title.ar: الاستيقاض قبل الفجر — طلب بركة بقية الليل

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، لَكَ الْمُلْكُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَنْتَ حَيٌّ قَيُّومٌ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta nurus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinna, wa lakal-hamdu anta qayyamus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinna, wa lakal-hamdu anta rabbus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinna, lakal-mulku la ilaha illa anta, subhanaka wa bihamdik, anta hayyun qayyum, la ilaha illa anta. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. Allahummastur 'awrati wa amin rau'ati. Allahummahfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi wa 'an yamini wa 'an shimali wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi'azamatika an ughtala min tahti.

translation.en: O Allah, for You is all praise. You are the Light of the heavens and the earth and all that is in them. For You is all praise. You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all that is in them. For You is all praise. You are the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is in them. To You belongs all sovereignty. There is none worthy of worship except You. Glory is to You and all praise. You are the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. There is none worthy of worship except You. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from before me, behind me, to my right, to my left, and from above me. I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unawares from beneath me.
translation.ar: اللهم لك الحمد أنت نور السماوات والأرض ومن فيهن ولك الحمد أنت قيام السماوات والأرض ومن فيهن ولك الحمد أنت رب السماوات والأرض ومن فيهن لك الملك لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك وبحمدك أنت حي قيوم لا إله إلا أنت اللهم إني أسألك العفو والعافية في الدنيا والآخرة اللهم إني أسألك العفو والعافية في ديني ودنياي وأهلي ومالي اللهم استر عوراتي وآمن روعاتي اللهم احفظني من بين يدي ومن خلفي وعن يميني وعن شمالي ومن فوقي وأعوذ بعظمتك أن أُغتال من تحتي

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said this comprehensive dua when he would wake up for the night prayer. It covers every aspect of protection: spiritual, physical, and in all directions. The dua asks for 'afw (pardon) and 'afiyah (well-being) in religion, worldly life, family, and wealth. It seeks Allah's concealment of one's faults and protection from every direction, including from beneath. (Sahih Ibn Hibban 968, graded Sahih).
virtues.ar: قال النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم) هذا الدعاء الشامل عند استيقاظه لصلاة الليل. يغطي كل جوانب الحماية: الروحية والجسدية ومن كل اتجاه (صحيح ابن حبان 968)

title.en: Seeking Protection Upon Waking — Amsina Bimallah

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-samai wa huwas-sami'ul-`aleem.

translation.en: In the Name of Allah, with Whose Name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
translation.ar: بسم الله الذي لا يضر مع اسمه شيء في الأرض ولا في السماء وهو السميع العليم

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever says upon waking: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-samai wa huwas-sami'ul-`aleem, nothing will harm him." (Sunan Abi Dawud 5088, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3388, graded Hasan Sahih). This is one of the most powerful protection supplications in Islam, and should be said immediately upon waking.
virtues.ar: قال النبي (صلى الله عليه وسلم): "من قال حين يصبح وبحسبه: بسم الله الذي لا يضر مع اسمه شيء في الأرض ولا في السماء وهو السميع العليم لم يضره شيء" (أبو داود 5088، الترمذي 3388)

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdih, SubhanAllahil-'Azim.

translation.en: Glory be to Allah and praise Him; glory be to Allah the Great.
translation.ar: سبحان الله وبحمده، سبحان الله العظيم

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Abu Hurairah; also recorded in Sahih Muslim 2694.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Two words are light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdih, SubhanAllahil-'Azim.' (Narrated by Abu Hurairah, Sahih al-Bukhari 6406, Sahih Muslim 2694.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «كلمتان خفيفتان على اللسان، ثقيلتان في الميزان، حبيبتان إلى الرحمن: سبحان الله وبحمده، سبحان الله العظيم» — رواه أبو هريرة، صحيح البخاري (6406) وصحيح مسلم (2694).

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illa-llah, wallahu akbar.

translation.en: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no deity except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
translation.ar: سبحان الله، والحمد لله، ولا إله إلا الله، والله أكبر

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Abu Hurairah; the most beloved speech to Allah, dearer than all that the sun rises upon.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'The most beloved of speech to Allah is four: SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illa Allah, and Allahu Akbar.' (Narrated by Abu Hurairah, Sahih Muslim 2695.) For me to say these is dearer to me than all that the sun rises upon.
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «أحب الكلام إلى الله أربع: سبحان الله، والحمد لله، ولا إله إلا الله، والله أكبر» — رواه أبو هريرة، صحيح مسلم (2695). ولهن أحب إليّ من كل ما طلعت عليه الشمس.

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa-llahu wahdahu la sharika lah...

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له...

virtues.en: 100× = 1,000 good deeds, 1,000 sins wiped, equals freeing 10 slaves, protection from Satan.
virtues.ar: من قالها مائة مرة كتبت له مائة حسنة.

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdih, 'adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsih, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midada kalimatih.

translation.en: Glory be to Allah and praise Him — by the number of His creation, by His pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the ink of His words.
translation.ar: سبحان الله وبحمده عدد خلقه...

virtues.en: Reciting this 3× equals hours of remembrance.
virtues.ar: لو وزنت بما قلت اليوم لوزنتهن.

title.en: La Hawla wa La Quwwata Illa Billah
title.ar: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله

items.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.

translation.en: There is no power and no strength except by Allah.
translation.ar: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Abu Musa al-Ash'ari; classed as a treasure from the treasures of Paradise.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah is a treasure from the treasures of Paradise.' (Narrated by Abu Musa al-Ash'ari, Sahih al-Bukhari 6610.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله كنز من كنوز الجنة» — رواه أبو موسى الأشعري، صحيح البخاري (6610).

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
items.transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala nabiyyina Muhammad.

translation.en: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
translation.ar: اللهم صل وسلم على نبينا محمد

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Abu Hurairah; the reward for one salawat is ten from Allah.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever sends blessings upon me once, Allah sends blessings upon him ten times.' (Narrated by Abu Hurairah, Sahih Muslim 408.)
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: «من صلى علي صلاة صلى الله عليه بها عشراً» — رواه أبو هريرة، صحيح مسلم (408).

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ. اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
items.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammad, wa 'ala aali Muhammad...

translation.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim...
translation.ar: اللهم صل على محمد...

reference.notes: Sahih — narrated by Ka'b bin Ujrah; this is the full salawat recited in the tashahhud of prayer.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ taught this comprehensive salawat to his Companions — the same one recited in the tashahhud of prayer. (Narrated by Ka'b bin Ujrah, Sahih al-Bukhari 6357.) Whoever sends blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ with it 10× morning and evening receives his intercession on the Day of Resurrection.
virtues.ar: علّم النبي ﷺ أصحابه هذه الصلاة الكاملة — وهي المقرؤة في التشهد — رواه كعب بن عجرة، صحيح البخاري (6357). ومن صلى على النبي ﷺ بها عشراً حين يصبح وعشراً حين يمسي أدركته شفاعته يوم القيامة.

title.ar: سبحان الله وبحمده ثم استغفر الله

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdih, astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh.

translation.en: Glory be to Allah and praise Him. I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.
translation.ar: سبحان الله وبحمده، أستغفر الله وأتوب إليه

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ would say this a hundred times a day.
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يقولهن في اليوم مائة مرة.

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah

translation.en: Glory be to Allah

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says SubhanAllah 33 times, Alhamdulillah 33 times, and Allahu Akbar 34 times after every obligatory prayer, that will be 100 on the tongue and 1000 on the Scale." The angels record these as expiation for minor sins committed since the last prayer. This is called the Tasbih Fatimi, taught by the Prophet to his daughter Fatimah and her husband Ali.

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah

translation.en: All praise is due to Allah

virtues.en: Part of the Tasbih Fatimi. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Alhamdulillah fills the scales." When combined with SubhanAllah and Allahu Akbar, all minor sins are forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea. (Sahih Muslim 595)

items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allahu Akbar

translation.en: Allah is the Greatest

virtues.en: Completes the 100 post-salah dhikr. The 34th repetition makes the total 100, expiating all minor sins since the last prayer. The Prophet ﷺ said these words are more beloved to me than everything upon which the sun rises. (Sahih Muslim 595)

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallah

translation.en: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The best of what I and the Prophets before me have said is: La ilaha illallah alone, with no partner." This is the greatest statement of Tawheed and the key to Paradise. (Bukhari 3186, Muslim 2697)

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi

translation.en: Glory be to Allah and all praise is due to Him

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi 100 times in the morning, no one will come on the Day of Judgment with anything better than what he has done, except one who says the same or more." This erases sins even if they are like the foam of the sea. (Bukhari 6405, Muslim 2692)

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsihi, wa zinata arshihi, wa midada kalimatihi

translation.en: Glory be to Allah and all praise is His, by the number of His creation, by the pleasure of His soul, by the weight of His Throne, and by the ink of His words.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said this is more beloved to him than everything upon which the sun rises. A comprehensive praise encompassing all of Allah's creation. (Muslim 2726)

title.en: SubhanAllah wal-hamdu lillah wa la ilaha illallah wallahu akbar
title.ar: سبحان الله والحمد لله ولا إله إلا الله والله أكبر

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah wal-hamdu lillah wa la ilaha illallah wallahu akbar

translation.en: Glory be to Allah, all praise is due to Allah, there is no deity except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest

virtues.en: These four words are the most beloved to Allah and His Messenger. The Prophet ﷺ said: "The most beloved words to Allah are four: SubhanAllah, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar." (Bukhari 3143, Muslim 2138)

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi rabbil-alamin

translation.en: All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds

virtues.en: This is the opening of the Quran and a praise that encompasses all forms of gratitude. The Prophet ﷺ said no people gather in a gathering without mentioning Allah except that it will be a source of regret for them on the Day of Judgment. (Abu Dawud 4855)

title.en: Allahu Akbaru kabira wal-hamdu lillahi kathira
title.ar: الله أكبر كبيرا والحمد لله كثيرا

items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
items.transliteration: Allahu Akbaru kabira wal-hamdu lillahi kathira wa subhanAllahi bukratan wa asilan

translation.en: Allah is the Greatest, much praise is due to Allah, and glory be to Allah morning and evening

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says Allahu Akbaru kabira, wal-hamdu lillahi kathira, wa subhanAllahi bukratan wa asilan — these words are more beloved to me than everything upon which the sun rises." (Muslim 2727)

items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullah

translation.en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ used to seek forgiveness more than 70 times a day despite being forgiven all his past and future sins. He said: "By Allah, I seek the forgiveness of Allah and I repent to Him more than seventy times each day." (Bukhari 6307)

title.en: Rabbi inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathira
title.ar: رب إني ظلمت نفسي ظلما كثيرا

items.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.transliteration: Rabbi inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathira, wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta faghfir li maghfiratan min indika warhamni innaka antal-ghafurur-raheem

translation.en: My Lord, I have wronged myself greatly, and no one forgives sins except You, so forgive me with a forgiveness from You and have mercy upon me. Indeed, You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ taught this comprehensive istighfar. Allah revealed: "Noah called to Us, and We are the best of responders." This dua was the key to salvation for Prophet Nuh and his followers. (Quran 71:10-12)

title.en: Astaghfirullaha alladhi la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum
title.ar: أستغفر الله الذي لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم

items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha alladhi la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum wa atubu ilayh

translation.en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah, besides Whom there is no deity, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I turn to Him in repentance.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says this istighfar, Allah will forgive him even if he fled from a battlefield." This is the most comprehensive form of istighfar known as Sayyidul-Istighfar. (Bukhari 6306, Tirmidhi 3577)

items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullahal-azeem wa atubu ilayh

translation.en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Magnificent and I turn to Him in repentance.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says Astaghfirullahal-azeem wa atubu ilayh, Allah will forgive him his sins even if he has deserted the army." A powerful and concise form of repentance. (Abu Dawud 1517, Tirmidhi 3577)

title.en: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-aliyyil-azeem
title.ar: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله العلي العظيم

items.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-aliyyil-azeem

translation.en: There is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great

virtues.en: An expanded form of the treasure of Jannah. Adding "al-aliyyil-azeem" magnifies the statement with Allah's supreme attributes. This was frequently recited by the Companions during times of difficulty. (Bukhari 6952)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
items.transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammadin, kama sallayta ala Ibrahim wa ala ali Ibrahim, innaka hamidun majid. Allahumma barik ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammadin, kama barakta ala Ibrahim wa ala ali Ibrahim, innaka hamidun majid

translation.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ taught this to his Companions and said it should be recited in the Tashahhud of every prayer. It is the most complete and authentic form of salawat. (Bukhari 3370, Muslim 406)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah

translation.en: In the name of Allah

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Any important matter not begun with Bismillah is incomplete (cut off from blessing)." Saying Bismillah before eating, drinking, wudu, and all actions brings barakah. It is the first verse of the Quran and the start of every Surah except At-Tawbah. (Abi Dawud 4840)

title.en: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma asmihi shay 3x
title.ar: بسم الله الذي لا يضر مع اسمه شيء

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma asmihi shay fil-ardi wa la fis-sama-i wa huwas-samiul-aleem

translation.en: In the Name of Allah, with Whose Name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says this, nothing will harm him." It is a shield against all harm and affliction. Ibn Abbas reported that the Prophet ﷺ taught him this and said nothing would harm him. (Abi Dawud 5088, Tirmidhi 3388)

items.arabic: صَدَقَ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ
items.transliteration: Sadaqallahul-azeem

translation.en: Allah the Almighty has spoken the truth

virtues.en: A common expression said after reciting the Quran as a confirmation of the truth of Allah's words. While not a hadith narration itself, it is a righteous practice of the scholars and Muslims throughout history.

items.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
items.transliteration: Jazakallahu khayran

translation.en: May Allah reward you with goodness

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "If one of you is given something, let him say Jazakallahu khayran. And whoever does more than that has praised him." When someone does good for you, this is the best response. (Tirmidhi 2036)

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan, wa fil-akhirati hasanatan, wa qina adhaban-nar

translation.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

virtues.en: One of the most frequent duas of the Prophet ﷺ. Anas reported that the Prophet used to make this dua frequently. It is a comprehensive dua covering both worlds. (Bukhari 6389, Quran 2:201)

items.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
items.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni mal-wakeel

translation.en: Allah is sufficient for us and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

virtues.en: Ibrahim (alayhis-salam) said this when thrown into the fire and it became cool and safe by Allah's command. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says it seven times morning and evening, Allah will suffice him for whatever concerns him." (Abu Dawud 4432)

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin

translation.en: There is no deity except You, exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "No Muslim ever says this concerning any matter except that Allah answers it." This dua of Prophet Yunus (alayhis-salam) from the belly of the whale is one of the most powerful duas for relief. (Tirmidhi 3505)

title.en: Allahumma innaka afuwwun tuhibbul-afwa fa fu anni 3x
title.ar: اللهم إنك عفو تحب العفو فاعف عني

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
items.transliteration: Allahumma innaka afuwwun tuhibbul-afwa fa fu anni

translation.en: O Allah, You are the Pardoner, You love to pardon, so pardon me.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ taught Aisha (RA) to say this during the last ten nights of Ramadan, especially when seeking Laylatul Qadr. It teaches us that the best approach is to ask for pardon rather than punishment. (Tirmidhi 3513)

items.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi zidni ilma

translation.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

virtues.en: The dua of Prophet Musa (alayhis-salam) in the Quran (20:114). A powerful dua seeking beneficial knowledge. The Prophet ﷺ emphasized seeking knowledge as an obligation upon every Muslim. This short but profound dua opens the doors of understanding. (Quran 20:114)

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (٣٣) الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣) اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤)
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah (33) Alhamdulillah (33) Allahu Akbar (34)

translation.en: Glory be to Allah (33) All praise is due to Allah (33) Allah is the Greatest (34)

virtues.en: Ali ibn Abi Talib and Fatimah (RA) asked the Prophet ﷺ for a servant due to their hardship. He said: "Shall I not tell you something better than what you asked for? When you go to bed, say SubhanAllah 33x, Alhamdulillah 33x, and Allahu Akbar 34x. That is better for you than a servant." (Bukhari 3705, Muslim 2727)

items.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum, la ta khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm

translation.en: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi when he goes to bed, a guardian from Allah will remain with him and no Shaytan will come near him until morning." This is one of the most powerful protections before sleep. (Bukhari 2311)

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa hayyun la yamutu biyadihil-khayru wa huwa ala kulli shay-in qadeer

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is Ever-Living and never dies. In His hand is all good, and He has power over everything.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever enters the market and says this, Allah will record for him a million good deeds, erase a million bad deeds, and raise him by a million degrees." (Tirmidhi 3428)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik

translation.en: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When one of you enters the mosque, let him say: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me. And when he leaves, let him say: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty." (Muslim 713)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as aluka min fadlik

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said to say this upon leaving the mosque, pairing it with the dua of entering. It completes the etiquette of visiting the House of Allah. (Muslim 713)

title.en: After Prayer: Allahumma antas-salamu wa minkas-salam

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma antas-salamu wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram

translation.en: O Allah, You are the Source of Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.

virtues.en: After saying Astaghfirullah 3x, the Prophet ﷺ would say this. It affirms that Allah is the ultimate source of peace and safety. A beautiful completion to the prayer. (Muslim 591)

title.en: After Prayer: La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku
title.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له بعد الصلاة

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay-in qadeer. Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayta wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minka al-jadd

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is over all things competent. O Allah, none can withhold what You have given, and none can give what You have withheld, and no wealth or fortune can benefit anyone against Your will.

virtues.en: After the tasbihat (33-33-34), the Prophet ﷺ would complete it with this comprehensive statement. The final part about "al-jadd" means no worldly fortune can help against Allah's decree. (Bukhari 844, Muslim 593)

title.ar: اللهم إني أسألك الجنة وأعوذ بك من النار

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as aluka al-jannah, wa a'udhu bika minan-nar

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek Your protection from the Fire.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever asks Allah for Paradise three times, Paradise will say: O Allah, admit him. And whoever seeks refuge from the Fire three times, the Fire will say: O Allah, save him from it." (Tirmidhi 2572)

title.en: SubhanAllah wal-hamdu lillah wa la ilaha illallah wallahu akbar wa la hawla

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah wal-hamdu lillah wa la ilaha illallah wallahu akbar wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

translation.en: Glory be to Allah, all praise is due to Allah, there is no deity except Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.

virtues.en: The five most comprehensive statements of dhikr combined. The Prophet ﷺ said these are the most beloved words to Allah. Combining them captures the essence of all worship: glorification, praise, monotheism, magnification, and reliance. (Bukhari 3143, Muslim 2138)

description.en: A broad collection of authentic daily supplications from the Sunnah, for use throughout the day.
description.ar: مجموعة واسعة من الأدعية اليومية الصحيحة من السنة، للاستخدام على مدار اليوم.

title.en: Praise for Being Given Life After Sleep
title.ar: الحمد لله الذي أحيانا بعدما أماتنا

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and unto Him is the resurrection.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) taught us to say this upon waking up. It is a reminder that sleep is a form of minor death and that life is a gift from Allah.

title.ar: التهليل عند الاستيقاظ من النوم بالليل

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadeer, subhanAllah, walhamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is over all things competent. Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, there is no deity except Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever wakes up at night and says this, then supplicates, his supplication will be answered. If he makes wudu and prays, his prayer will be accepted.

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي رَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي وَعَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahilladhi radda `alayya ruhi, wa `afani fi jasadi, wa adhina li bidhikrihi

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who has returned my soul to me, given health to my body, and allowed me to remember Him.

virtues.en: A beautiful expression of gratitude for the blessings of life, health, and the ability to engage in dhikr each morning.

items.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
items.transliteration: Ashhadu alla ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluh

translation.en: I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah, alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.

virtues.en: Affirming the shahadah upon waking is a sunnah that renews one's faith and reminds the believer of their purpose.

title.en: Last Two Verses of Al-Baqarah Upon Waking

items.arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ۞ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا ۚ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ۚ وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Amanar-rasulu bima unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal-mu'minun, kullun amana billahi wa mala'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi, la nafarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulihi, wa qalu sami'na wa ata'na, ghufiranaka rabbana wa ilaykal-masir. La yukallifullahu nafsan illa wus'aha, laha ma kasabat wa `alayha maktasabat, rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na, rabbana wa la tahmil `alayna isran kama hamaltahu `alalladhina min qablina, rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih, wa `fu `anna, waghfir lana, warhamna, anta mawlana fansurna `alal-qawmil-kafirin

translation.en: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, saying, "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. Your forgiveness, our Lord. And to You is the final destination." Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear. It will have what it has earned, and it will be responsible for what it has earned. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not burden us with that which You have not burdened upon those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with that which we have no capacity to bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.

virtues.en: Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him. (Sahih al-Bukhari 4009)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik

translation.en: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.

virtues.en: A short but powerful supplication to seek Allah's mercy upon entering the house of Allah.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.

virtues.en: Upon leaving the mosque, one asks Allah for His boundless favor and grace.

title.en: Praying Two Rak'ahs Upon Entering the Mosque (Tahiyyatul Masjid)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Bismillah, was-salatu was-salamu `ala rasulillah, Allahummaghfir li dhunubi waftah li abwaba rahmatik

translation.en: In the name of Allah, and blessings and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, forgive my sins and open the gates of Your mercy for me.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: When one of you enters the mosque, let him pray two rak'ahs before sitting down. (Sahih al-Bukhari 444, Sahih Muslim 714)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah

translation.en: In the name of Allah.

virtues.en: Beginning wudu with Bismillah is a sunnah. There is no valid wudu without mentioning the name of Allah according to some scholars.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
items.transliteration: Allahummaj'alni minat-tawwabin waj'alni minal-mutatahhirin

translation.en: O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves.

virtues.en: A beautiful dua asking Allah to make one steadfast in repentance and purification. Graded Hasan by at-Tirmidhi, Sahih by Al-Albani.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
items.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa `ala rabbina tawakkalna

translation.en: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we exit, and upon our Lord we rely.

virtues.en: A sunnah of mentioning Allah when entering and exiting one's home, showing reliance on Allah in all affairs.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi, tawakkaltu `alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah

translation.en: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: When a man leaves his house and says Bismillah, tawakkaltu `alallah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah, it is said to him: You are guided, sufficed, and protected. The Shaytan becomes distant from him. (Sunan Abi Dawud 5095, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3426)

items.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
items.transliteration: As-salamu `alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh

translation.en: Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) instructed Anas to greet his family with salam when entering the home. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5893)

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahilladhi kasani hadhath-thawba wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or might of my own.

virtues.en: An expression of gratitude acknowledging that all provision comes from Allah alone, not from one's own efforts.

title.en: Dua for Blessing in New Clothes

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهُ وَخَيْرَ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtanihi, as'aluka khayrahu wa khayra ma suni'a lah, wa a'udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lah

translation.en: O Allah, all praise is for You, for You are the One who has clothed me. I ask You for its good and the good of that for which it was made, and I seek Your refuge from its evil and the evil of that for which it was made.

virtues.en: A comprehensive dua that seeks the good and seeks protection from any harm in what one wears. Graded Hasan by at-Tirmidhi, Sahih by Al-Albani.

title.en: Dua When Looking in the Mirror

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ كَمَا أَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِي فَأَحْسِنْ خُلُقِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma kama ahsanta khalqi fa ahsin khuluqi

translation.en: O Allah, just as You have made my external appearance good, make my character good.

reference.collection: Musnad Ahmad 6/155, graded Sahih by Al-Albani

virtues.en: This beautiful dua connects outward beauty with inner character, reminding us that good character is the true beauty in the sight of Allah.

title.en: Sleep Dua: Life and Death in Allah's Name

items.arabic: بِسْمِكَ اَللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
items.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya

translation.en: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would place his hand under his cheek and say this before sleeping. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6312, Sahih Muslim 2711)

title.en: Sleep Dua: Placing One's Side Down

items.arabic: بِسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Bismika rabbi wada'tu janbi, wa bika arfa'uh, fa-in amsakta nafsi farhamha, wa-in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi `ibadakas-salihin

translation.en: In Your name, my Lord, I lay my side down, and by You I raise it. If You take my soul, have mercy upon it, and if You release it, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.

virtues.en: One of the most comprehensive sleep duas, surrendering one's soul to Allah whether in sleep or death.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhalladhi yashfa'u `indahu illa bi-idhnihi, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'in min `ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma, wa huwal-`aliyyul-`azim

translation.en: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever recites Ayatul Kursi when going to bed, there will remain a guardian from Allah over him and no Shaytan will come near him until morning. (Sahih al-Bukhari 2311)

items.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۞ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۞ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Qul huwallahu ahad. Qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq. Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas

translation.en: Say: He is Allah, the One. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) instructed to recite Surah Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas, then blow into one's hands and wipe over the body. Nothing harmed him, and it was sufficient for everything. (Sahih al-Bukhari 2311, Sahih Muslim 2713)

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (٣٣) اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣) اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤)
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah (33) Alhamdulillah (33) Allahu Akbar (34)

translation.en: Glory be to Allah (33 times), all praise is for Allah (33 times), Allah is the Greatest (34 times).

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said to Fatimah: Shall I not tell you something that is better for you than a servant? Say SubhanAllah 33 times, Alhamdulillah 33 times, and Allahu Akbar 34 times when you go to bed. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5957, Sahih Muslim 2723)

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah

translation.en: All praise is for Allah.

virtues.en: When a person sneezes, they should say Alhamdulillah, praising Allah who has revived them after every sneeze (which is like a small death). The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Allah likes the act of sneezing and dislikes the act of yawning. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6223, Sahih Muslim 2991)

items.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: Yarhamukallahu

translation.en: May Allah have mercy upon you.

virtues.en: When someone sneezes and says Alhamdulillah, the one who hears it should reply: Yarhamukallahu (May Allah have mercy on you). The sneezer then replies: Yahdikumullah wa yuslihu balakum (May Allah guide you and rectify your affairs). (Sahih al-Bukhari 6223, Sahih Muslim 2991)

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllahilladhi yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihi wal-mala'ikatu min kheefatihi

translation.en: Glory be to the One whom thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels out of fear of Him.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would say this when hearing thunder. He would also say: This is a severe warning to the people of the earth. (Muwatta Malik, Sunan Abi Dawud 5099)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'an

translation.en: O Allah, make it a beneficial rain.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would say this when he saw rain falling, asking Allah to make it a source of benefit and blessing. (Sahih al-Bukhari 1032)

items.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: La ba'sa tahurun insha Allah

translation.en: No harm, it is a purification, if Allah wills.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would visit the sick and say these comforting words, reminding them that illness is a means of expiation for sins. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5652, Sahih Muslim 2192)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِهِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma rabban-nas, adhhibil-ba's, ishfi wa antash-shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uka, shifa'an la yughadiru saqaman

translation.en: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the affliction. Heal him, for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing — a healing that leaves no illness.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would visit the sick, place his hand on the sick person's forehead and say this dua seven times. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5651, Sahih Muslim 2191)

items.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اَللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
items.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un, Allahumma'jurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha

translation.en: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and compensate me with something better.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: There is no Muslim who is afflicted with a calamity and says what Allah has commanded (Inna lillahi...) and then says: Allahumma'jurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha — except that Allah compensates him with something better. (Sahih Muslim 918)

items.arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَىٰ، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى، فَاصْبِرْ وَاحْتَسِبْ
items.transliteration: Inna lillahi ma akhadha wa lahu ma a'ta, wa kullu shay'in `indahu bi-ajalin musamma, fasbir wahtasib

translation.en: Indeed, to Allah belongs what He has taken, and to Him belongs what He has given, and everything with Him has an appointed term. So be patient and seek reward.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would say this to console the bereaved, reminding them that all matters are with Allah and to be patient seeking His reward. (Sahih al-Bukhari 1284)

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahilladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alna muslimeen

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims.

virtues.en: A comprehensive expression of gratitude for food, drink, and the blessing of Islam.

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًىٰ عَنْهُ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarkan fih, ghayra makfiyyin wa la muwadda'in wa la mustaghna `anhu

translation.en: All praise is for Allah, a praise that is abundant, pure, and full of blessings — a praise that is neither insufficient nor abandoned, and which we can never be without.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) ate with a group and when he finished he said: Indeed, a servant of Allah ate food and praised Allah for it and was given a full reward. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5458, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3459)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba'ith

translation.en: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female devils.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: When any of you enters the toilet, he should say Bismillah and seek refuge from the devils. (Sahih al-Bukhari 142, Sahih Muslim 375)

items.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
items.transliteration: Ghufranak

translation.en: I seek Your forgiveness.

virtues.en: A short expression of seeking Allah's forgiveness after leaving the bathroom, thanking Him for the blessing of removal of harm. (Sunan Abi Dawud 30)

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
items.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem

translation.en: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: I know a word which, if he were to say it, what he feels would go away. If he says: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem, it would go away from him. (Sahih al-Bukhari 3282, Sahih Muslim 2610)

items.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
items.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakeel

translation.en: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

virtues.en: Ibrahim (عليه السلام) said this when he was thrown into the fire, and Allah made the fire cool and safe for him. The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever says it in a matter that concerns him, Allah suffices him in that matter. (Sahih al-Bukhari 3861)

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin

translation.en: There is no deity except You, exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: No Muslim ever says this concerning any matter except that Allah answers it. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3505)

title.en: Dua for Parents: Mercy as They Raised You

items.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi rhamhuma kama rabbayani sagheeran

translation.en: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.

virtues.en: A Quranic dua that beautifully parallels the mercy parents showed in raising their child. Part of the comprehensive guidance in Surah Al-Isra about treating parents with excellence.

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir li wa li-walidayya wal-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day the account is established.

virtues.en: A dua of Ibrahim (عليه السلام) that the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) also used, extending forgiveness to parents and all believers.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ
items.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li wa li-walidayya

translation.en: O Allah, forgive me and my parents.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would frequently make dua for his parents after their passing, showing that dua for parents continues even after death. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi)

title.en: Seeking Refuge from a Bad Neighbor

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَارِ السُّوءِ فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ، فَإِنَّ الْجَارَ الْبَارَّ إِذَا شَاهَدَ خَيْرًا أَعَانَهُ، وَإِذَا رَأَىٰ سُوءًا سَتَرَهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min jari-s-su'i fi daril-muqamah, fa-innal-jaral-barra idha shahada khayran a'anahu, wa idha ra'a su'an satarahu

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a bad neighbor in my permanent dwelling, for the righteous neighbor, when he sees good, he assists, and when he sees evil, he covers it.

virtues.en: Islam places great emphasis on good neighborly relations. This dua seeks Allah's protection from a harmful neighbor and implicitly asks for a righteous one.

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumit, wa huwa hayyun la yamut, biyadihil-khayr, wa huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadeer

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is the Ever-Living who never dies. In His hand is all good, and He is over all things competent.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever enters the market and says this, Allah will record for him a million good deeds, erase a million bad deeds, and raise him by a million ranks. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3428)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
items.transliteration: Bismillah, subhanAllahilladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun

translation.en: In the name of Allah. Glory be to the One who has subjugated this for us, though we could not have subjugated it by ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we will return.

virtues.en: This dua, derived from the Quran (43:13-14), is recited upon boarding any form of transport, acknowledging that the ability to travel is from Allah. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3446, Sunan Abi Dawud 2602)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ، اَللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
items.transliteration: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, subhanAllahilladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun, Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda, Allahumma hawwin `alayna safarana hadha watwi `anna bu'dah, Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safari wal-khalifatu fil-ahli, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'is-safari wa ka'abatil-manzari wa su'il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahli

translation.en: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to the One who has subjugated this for us, though we could not have subjugated it, and indeed to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You in this journey of ours for righteousness, piety, and deeds that are pleasing to You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Successor over the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, from a gloomy sight, and from a bad outcome regarding wealth and family.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would say this upon mounting his riding animal for travel. (Sahih Muslim 2722)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Allahummaghfir lahu warhamhu, wa `afihi wa `fu `anhu, wa akrim nuzulah, wa wassi' mudkhalah, waghislihil-ma'a wath-thalji wal-barad, wa naqqihu minal-khataya kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas, wa abdilhu daran khayran min darihi, wa ahalan khayran min ahlihi, wa zawjan khayran min zawjihi, wa adkhihil-jannah, wa a'idhu min `adhabil-qabri wa `adhabin-nar

translation.en: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy upon him, give him well-being and pardon him, honor his arrival, widen his entrance, wash him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him from sins as a white garment is purified from filth. Replace for him a home better than his home, a family better than his family, and a spouse better than his spouse. Admit him into Paradise and protect him from the torment of the grave and the torment of the Fire.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) taught this dua to be recited in the funeral prayer. For a female, replace pronouns accordingly. (Sahih Muslim 963)

items.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَلَاحِقُونَ، نَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
items.transliteration: As-salamu `alaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu'minina wal-muslimin, wa inna insha Allahu bikum lalahiqun, nas'alullaha lana wa lakumul-`afiyah

translation.en: Peace be upon you, O people of the dwellings, from among the believers and the Muslims. Indeed, if Allah wills, we will join you. We ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would visit the graveyard and give this salam to the deceased, teaching that the dead can hear the greeting. (Sahih Muslim 974, Sahih al-Bukhari 1327)

title.en: Dua When Lowering the Deceased into the Grave
title.ar: الدعاء عند وضع الميت في القبر

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَىٰ مِلَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi wa `ala millati rasulillahi sallallahu `alayhi wa sallam

translation.en: In the name of Allah and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وسلم).

virtues.en: This is said when placing the deceased into the grave, affirming that the deceased followed the way of the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم). Then one makes dua: O Allah, so-and-so is in Your protection and the rope of Your neighborhood, so protect him from the trial of the grave and the punishment of the Fire. (Sahih Muslim 863, Sunan Abi Dawud 3202)

items.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: Dhahabaz-zama'u wa-abtallatil-'uruq wa thabatal-ajru insha Allah

translation.en: Thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) would say this upon breaking his fast. (Sunan Abi Dawud 2357)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَعَلَىٰ رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma laka sumtu wa `ala rizqika aftartu

translation.en: O Allah, for You I have fasted, and upon Your provision I have broken my fast.

virtues.en: A beautiful dua affirming that the fast was solely for Allah and the breaking of fast is through His provision. (Sunan Abi Dawud 2358)

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اَللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
items.transliteration: Bismillah, Allahumma jannibnash-shaytana wa jannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana

translation.en: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the Shaytan away from us and keep the Shaytan away from what You provide us.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: If one of you says this before intimacy, and a child is decreed from that act, no Shaytan will ever harm that child. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5285, Sahih Muslim 1434)

items.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
items.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdulillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadeer, rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa khayra ma ba'dah, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa sharri ma ba'dah

translation.en: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no deity except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things competent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it.

virtues.en: A comprehensive morning dua combining tawheed, praise, and supplication for good and protection from evil throughout the day. (Sahih Muslim 2711)

items.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
items.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah, walhamdulillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadeer, rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhil-laylati wa khayra ma ba'daha, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhil-laylati wa sharri ma ba'daha

translation.en: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no deity except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things competent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it.

virtues.en: The evening counterpart of the morning dua, seeking Allah's good and protection throughout the night. (Sahih Muslim 2711)

title.en: Morning & Evening: Life and Death Belong to Allah

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur

translation.en: O Allah, by Your grace we enter the morning, and by Your grace we enter the evening. By You we live, by You we die, and unto You is the resurrection.

virtues.en: The morning version of this comprehensive dua affirms total dependence on Allah for all states of existence. The evening version replaces asbahna with amsayna. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3391)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana `abduka, wa ana `ala `ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bini'matika `alayya, wa abu'u bidhambi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant

translation.en: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I am upon Your covenant and Your promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me and I acknowledge my sins, so forgive me, for indeed none can forgive sins except You.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever says this in the evening and then dies, he enters Paradise. And whoever says it in the morning and then dies, he enters Paradise. It is called Sayyidul Istighfar — the master of all forgiveness. (Sunan al-Bukhari (in Al-Adab Al-Mufrad), Sunan Abi Dawud 5069, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3392)

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi

translation.en: Glory be to Allah and all praise is His.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever says SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi 100 times in the morning and 100 times in the evening, no one will come on the Day of Judgment with something better than what he has, except one who says the same or more. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6405, Sahih Muslim 2692)

title.en: Dua for Good in This World and the Next

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan, wa fil-akhirati hasanatan, wa qina `adhaban-nar

translation.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

virtues.en: One of the most frequently recited duas of the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم), encompassing all needs of this life and the next. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6389)

title.en: Dua for the Night of Decree (Laylatul Qadr)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
items.transliteration: Allahumma innaka `afuwwun tuhibbul-`afwa fa `fu `anni

translation.en: O Allah, You are the Pardoner, You love to pardon, so pardon me.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) taught Aisha to say this when seeking Laylatul Qadr in the last ten nights of Ramadan. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3513)

items.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi zidni `ilma

translation.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

virtues.en: The dua of Musa (عليه السلام) in the Quran (20:114), a powerful and concise prayer seeking beneficial knowledge from Allah.

title.ar: بسم الله الذي لا يضر مع اسمه شيء

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-samai wa huwas-sami`ul-`aleem

translation.en: In the Name of Allah, with Whose Name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever recites this, nothing will harm him. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3388, Sunan Abi Dawud 5088)

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
items.transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim `ala nabiyyina Muhammad

translation.en: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever sends one blessing upon me, Allah will send ten blessings upon him. (Sahih Muslim 408)

title.en: Dua for Paradise and Refuge from Fire

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-jannah, wa a'udhu bika minan-nar

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek Your refuge from the Fire.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever asks Allah for Paradise three times, Paradise will say: O Allah, admit him. And whoever seeks refuge from the Fire three times, the Fire will say: O Allah, save him. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 2572)

title.en: Seeking Refuge from Grief and Sorrow

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَاتِ الرِّجَالِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-`ajzi wal-kasal, wal-jubni wal-bukhli, wa dal`id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from grief and sorrow, from weakness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and the domination of men.

reference.collection: Sunan Abi Dawud 5090, Sunan Ibn Majah 3883

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) used to teach his companions this comprehensive dua. (Sunan Abi Dawud 5090, Sunan Ibn Majah 3883)

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadeer

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is over all things competent.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: Whoever says this 100 times daily, it will be a ransom for him from the Fire, and whoever says it 10 times daily, 100 good deeds will be recorded for him and 100 sins will be erased. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6403, Sahih Muslim 2691)

title.en: Seeking Refuge from the Removal of Blessings

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min zawali ni'matik, wa tahawwuli `afiyatik, wa fuja'ati niqmatik, wa jami'i sakhatik

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the removal of Your blessing, the change of Your well-being, the suddenness of Your punishment, and from all of Your displeasure.

virtues.en: The Prophet (صلى الله عليه وسلم) made this dua in every prayer. (Sahih Muslim 2734)

title.en: Dua of Distress: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum
title.ar: دعاء الكرب: يا حي يا قيوم

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا بِسَمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمَتُّ، اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا بِسَمِكَ أَحْيَا، اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma rabbana bismikallahumma amut, Allahumma rabbana bismika ahya, Allahummaghfir li

translation.en: O Allah, our Lord, by Your name I die. O Allah, our Lord, by Your name I live. O Allah, forgive me.

virtues.en: A concise dua for moments of distress, affirming life and death are in Allah's hands while seeking His forgiveness. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3551)
